v0.8.175 Stable2026-10-19T14:58:04Z

HyperFrames v0.8.175

Released on 2026-10-19.

Long films now play smoothly deep into the timeline, because the preview only does work for what is on screen. Cloud downloads resume after a dropped connection, and check, inspect and renders get going faster.

Fixes

  • Core: The preview keeps playing in time when its tab is hidden (b168d0b41, #5872).
  • CLI: A cloud render download that loses its connection picks up where it stopped (cea0bad79, #5873).

Performance

  • Core: Long films keep their frame rate deep into the timeline: playback and jumps do only the work for what is on screen (959dd3e58, #5754).
  • CLI: Check and inspect finish faster: they skip paint waits and screenshots nothing reads (843494578, #5868).
  • Producer: Renders embed a project's local fonts as they are, so setup is faster (2b57809d7, #5865).

Internal

  • Stop the fallow audit hook from piling up base snapshots (aa63a8c70, #5882).

v0.8.174 Stable2026-10-19T02:28:14Z

HyperFrames v0.8.174

Released on 2026-10-19.

Deleting a time range from a timeline clip now removes only that range, not the whole clip. Cloud renders download faster, and Lambda renders assemble in seconds and scale to your account's limits.

Fixes

  • CLI: Timeline delete --start/--end removes only that range (d2b8ea76443, #5867).
  • Core: Color grading applies to canvas compositions (5658f700650, #5860).
  • Core: Format generated artifacts without spawning bun from PATH (d369159305c, #5859).
  • CLI: A page-load timeout names the script or stylesheet the page was waiting on (adb7a6c994b, #5727).
  • CLI: Capture keeps other screenshots when Chrome refuses one (a9190303565, #5739).
  • Engine: Exports carry full colour tags with every encoder, SDR and HDR (ea742c50188, #5742).
  • Lint: Back-to-back audio clips no longer count as overlapping after float rounding (d1123299f8a, #5837).
  • CLI: Preview inside a host app's agent run no longer outlives the run (bf24fda8dab, #5852).
  • CLI: Init writes the project into a folder with a non-ASCII name on Windows (d58d3edd39b, #5833).
  • CLI: A render no FFmpeg encoder can finish stops before capture, not after it (9fd5e4ae2df, #5831).

Performance

  • AWS Lambda: Size distributed renders from account concurrency limits (2a14cbc924a, #5813).
  • Cloud: Assemble chunk output with a single faststart index (70fbe32f8d9, #5812).
  • CLI: Cloud render downloads the finished video over parallel connections (cddb34feacf, #5864).

Docs & Examples

  • CLI: Say capture needs direct internet and ignores HTTPS_PROXY (26d7dbca360, #5752).
  • Skills: Make reference guides directly discoverable (388011b2147, #5858).

Internal

  • Engine: Process tracker tests spawn node, not shell tools, so Windows runs stop timing out (b98a1ac6e03, #5832).

Full changelog

https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/compare/v0.8.173...v0.8.174

v0.8.173 Stable2026-10-18T21:43:08Z

HyperFrames v0.8.173

Released on 2026-10-18.

Studio's install button now walks you through download, install and open in one card, and never dead-ends. Camera clips shot at 29.97 fps export smoothly at 30 fps, and check waits for slow CDN scripts the way render does.

Features

  • Studio: The desktop-app button says Install the desktop app and never dead-ends (5975dd7579b, #5854).

Fixes

  • Engine: A 29.97 fps camera clip exports smoothly at 30 fps (b46ebedeae9, #5849).
  • CLI: Check and snapshot wait for a slow CDN script as long as render does (18fc3901c79, #5847).
  • CLI: Agents can apply a color correction from media-treatment's capabilities (e31838159d9, #5850).

Internal

  • Lint: Shader lint tests pass on macOS, where the temp folder is a symlink (a971c2bb257, #5851).

Full changelog

v0.8.172 Stable2026-10-18T16:20:03Z

HyperFrames v0.8.172

Released on 2026-10-18.

Check and snapshot keep their report when another app has the project open, and capture works inside an agent sandbox. Audio finds the same files as preview, and later scenes no longer leak grain early.

Fixes

  • CLI: Check and snapshot keep their record while another app has the history open (01adadb9181, #5845).
  • CLI: Audio and timeline find media the way preview and render load it (ab2e939558b, #5846).
  • Core: A scene paints no SVG filter grain before its start or after its end (bb55640f5c6, #5828).
  • CLI: Capture works inside an agent's macOS sandbox (dc0e80e73af, #5840).

v0.21.21 Stable2026-10-19T14:18:52Z

oh-my-codex 0.21.21

0.21.21 is a patch release for Windows shim path correctness, stale-launcher warning improvements, team worker readiness enforcement, and dynamic version handling in tests (5 commits, 7 files, +174/−104; PRs #3833, #3835, #3837).

Highlights

  • Windows shim path generation on POSIX (#3833): Fix path generation for Windows shims on POSIX systems to use host paths instead of stray backslash-prefixed paths. Filesystem writes in setup/uninstall/codex-hooks no longer create unintended \tmp\… entries.
  • Team worker readiness deadline (#3835): Enforce the configured readiness deadline on the final poll, preventing team worker readiness from reporting ready after the timeout expires.
  • Stale-launcher warning diagnostics (#3837): Restore test coverage for stale-launcher warnings and split messaging by provenance reason (missing-launcher vs. incompatible provenance). Diagnostic output is more specific and test assertions are comprehensive.

Compatibility

  • Setup/uninstall operations on POSIX systems now generate correct host paths for Windows shim artifacts.
  • Stale-launcher warning behavior is unchanged; test coverage is restored and messaging is more specific.

Validation

  • Pinned candidate 3a03651f0a989b7328987b5de9d1ee6ef89154dd passed latest-per-name dev CI: 24 checks succeeded and 1 conditional check was skipped, with no failures.
  • Release branch CI passed with all required checks green.
  • All code review findings resolved.

oh-my-codex v0.21.20

0.21.20 is a patch release for team worker readiness deadline enforcement during the final poll (2 commits, 8 files, +110/−18; PR #3835).

Highlights

  • Readiness deadline enforcement (#3835): enforce the configured OMX_TEAM_READY_TIMEOUT_MS timeout on the final team worker readiness poll, preventing team workers from reporting ready after the deadline. Incompatibility markers remain fail-closed.

Compatibility

  • Readiness behavior is more deterministic and compatible with configured timeout expectations.

v0.21.19 Stable2026-10-19T06:18:46Z

oh-my-codex v0.21.19

0.21.19 is a patch release for agent model configuration and third-party provider fixes with correctness improvements for profile-scoped model resolution and provider classification (19 commits, 16 files, +925/−41; PRs #3824, #3825, #3827, #3828, #3829, #3831, #3832).

Highlights

  • Third-party provider model pins (#3824, fixing #3823): stop baking exactModel pins for agents using third-party providers, allowing providers to rotate their default models while keeping agents resolvable. Reported by @hetingyi.
  • Runtime-inherited model detection (#3825, fixing #3822): align omx doctor spark-lane model checks with runtime-inherited agent model behavior, eliminating false positives that omx setup --force could never clear. Reported by @hetingyi.
  • Profile-scoped model overrides (#3827): honor profile-scoped agent model settings and override guidance in generated agent runtime config.
  • Effective profile model resolution (#3831): resolve active profile models before built-in fallbacks, keep exact pins when built-in providers omit models, and avoid claiming fallback models for provider-only configs.
  • Provider classification normalization (#3832): normalize provider IDs consistently to preserve case sensitivity while ensuring matching behavior across configuration generation, exact pins, and metadata.
  • Final readiness poll (#3829, #3832): always perform final team readiness poll before the timeout deadline and prevent startup from blocking when timeout budget is exhausted.

Compatibility

  • Agent generation and setup now correctly handle third-party provider model changes without requiring reinstallation.
  • Doctor diagnostics no longer report valid runtime-inherited configurations as stale.
  • Profile-scoped model overrides are now applied to all agents, not just those with explicit pin overrides.
  • Built-in provider model resolution now correctly reflects configured models across generation, pinning, and metadata.
  • Team startup respects configured readiness timeout boundaries.

  • Release branch CI passed with all required checks green after rerunning known flakes (macOS Ralplan preflight at 30m timeout).
  • All Codex review findings resolved across release branch and dev merge.

v0.5.1 Stable2026-10-19T13:37:45Z

OpenViking v0.5.1

中文

本版本包含 v0.5.0 之后的 151 个提交，重点是 Gateway 部署与接入、隐私字段管理、批量写入、多模态检索，以及 Session 和后台任务的可靠性。升级前请阅读下方兼容性与迁移：本次涉及 API 删除、写入语义和存储格式变化。

主要更新

  • Gateway 可以直接运行在 OpenViking Server 内。 开启 gateway.enabled 后，模型请求和管理接口统一位于 /gateway；独立部署仍受支持。Studio 新增快速配置、从 Server 导入模型设置和真实模型生成测试；上游支持精确 endpoint、自定义认证头及 URL 中的 key 占位符，覆盖 Azure 等接入方式。管理密钥与用户身份分开，配置了管理密钥后，修改上游和 context profile 必须提供它。请求准备、响应转发和历史响应查找也减少了 CPU 开销（#5960、#6100、#6101、#6107、#6118、#6026）。

  • 隐私配置支持字段级引用和原子更新。 ov privacy reference 默认返回绑定 owner 的引用，resolve 才显式读取值；新增字段元数据、字段/目标删除、原子 PATCH，以及对已存内容的扫描和修复。扫描默认 dry-run，返回引用而不返回命中原值；多个字段登记了同一个值时报告歧义。修复单文件 no-split 导入的隐私处理（#6161、#6260）。

  • 批量写入支持更多处理选项。 batch_write 新增整批 processing_mode，每个文件可带 tags 和 ACL；增加内容版本冲突检查及保留冲突文件的选项。变化文件统一维护语义与向量，vectors_only 不刷新父目录语义。正文已写入后，后台刷新入队失败会如实报错，正文不会回滚（#5897、#5750）。

  • 检索支持文字与多图组合。 find、search 的 image_url 可传有序图片数组，Python SDK 支持对应输入；需要兼容的多模态 embedding。CLI 新增 ov search --mode context，可直接输出组装好的上下文。修复召回过的目录阻挡其下新文件的问题，缩短并限制 query planner 的处理，Hermes 排序移除字面词重叠加分（#6128、#5951、#5982、#6039、#6007、#5712）。

  • Session 和任务状态更准确。 统一 task 与 queue work 跟踪，保留任务 owner；SessionCommit 第二阶段失败会进入终态错误，归档完成标记在任务结果保存后写入；注册任务前释放归档锁。减少消息写入、Session 接口和删除时的重复读取，移除文件任务存储的统一 I/O 限流；资源 reason 触发的记忆抽取入队后即可返回受理状态（#6043、#6122、#6136、#5772、#6153、#6175、#6270、#6165、#6265、#6077、#6157）。

  • 多实例部署能力增加。 Session idle auto-commit 可选 Redis 分布式调度；Account Store 新增 MySQL 和 Redis+MySQL Provider，默认仍为 file。顶层 service_name 统一部署标识及共享缓存命名；多写存储升级为 V2 分区日志、checkpoint 和后台追平模型（#6046、#5933、#5955、#6011、#6014、#5741）。

  • Compile 和 Studio。 VikingBot Compile 使用可规划的 Map/Shuffle/Reduce 流程，增加临时路由 embedding 接口，并限制失败重试和停滞的 review 循环。Studio 改进 workspace 设置、连接恢复、模型配置及私有地址连接测试；ROOT 可保存启动配置并重启受支持的单 worker 服务，启动失败时尝试恢复之前实际运行的配置（#5750、#5989、#6133、#6066、#6148、#6177、#5730）。

  • Agent 集成。 新增 Microsoft Agent Framework context provider；LangChain/LangGraph 修复 mapping、文本块、异步初始化和健康状态识别，框架包移到 integrations/frameworks/。共享插件新增 ov-resources skill、透传额外请求头和召回排除项；DSH 在压缩/启动时提交待处理消息；OpenCode 修复 session 归属和过期状态清理；Hermes Quick Local 支持 OpenViking 0.5（#5578、#6017、#5980、#6070、#5908、#5878、#6092、#5988、#5616、#5254、#6243、#5935、#5936、#6114）。

  • 可靠性、安全与观测。 统一模型错误分类和重试边界，识别 Ark 超时，保留输入错误、鉴权失败、超时和网络错误的区别；修复长 embedding 输入截断、PDFium 并发渲染、SVG 依赖、加密快照恢复、原生向量存储错误透传及租户过滤。新增 Connector 导入计数和按来源区分的 ingestion token 指标（#6047、#5950、#6102、#6045、#5771、#5952、#6049、#6052、#5803、#5945、#6245）。

  • MCP 下载原文件。 新增 download(uri) 工具，返回一次性下载链接，默认约 10 分钟有效；Gateway 可代理文件链接。链接不需要 OpenViking API key，但部署在额外鉴权代理后时仍需该代理要求的请求头（#6119）。

  • 提交与锁释放修复。 Session 在入队前创建 Task 并绑定 owner，修复 commit 返回 500；写入协调消息在生产方交锁及所属工作结束后释放锁，修复写入完成后移动、覆盖和删除仍返回 409。同时修复跨进程交接锁的本地状态清理，以及 HTTP 向量存储读取返回字段的问题（#6258、#6300、#6281、#6193）。

  • 任务后端、解析与接入。 Task/Work 可选 MySQL 持久化后端（默认仍为 file）；parser 新增 parsers.download_temp_dir，允许底层文件系统支持的仅大小写不同文件名。Gateway 避免 DSH 和无工具辅助请求产生重复召回或新会话，LangChain 保留会话角色和工具历史；记忆更新重新读取失败时不再用旧快照覆盖（#6258、#6298、#6295、#6275、#6075）。Studio 完善界面本地化，Gateway 文档增加独立接入章节（#6292、#6287）。

用法示例

# 主包和 Python SDK
pip install --upgrade 'openviking==0.5.1' 'openviking-sdk==0.1.16'

# 独立 CLI
npm install -g @openviking/cli@0.5.1

# 组装上下文；完整结构使用 -o json
ov search '最近的设计决策' --mode context --events-time-decay-protection 7d

# 只获取隐私字段引用，不读取明文值
ov privacy reference credential github-prod api_key

# Python SDK 0.1.16；服务端需配置支持多模态输入的 embedding
result = client.find(
    query="比较这两张图的共同主题",
    image=["./first.png", "./second.png"],
    limit=5,
)

兼容性与迁移

  1. Gateway 地址、管理权限和存储迁移（#5960、#6100）。 先停止旧进程并备份完整 storage_path。客户端地址从 http://host:1935/v1 改为 http://host:1933/gateway/v1；Anthropic 使用 http://host:1933/gateway。独立网关默认仍监听 1935，但同样使用 /gateway 前缀。管理 API 从 /api/v1/admin/gateway/* 改为 /gateway/admin/*。嵌入部署移除 sidecar 和旧端口配置，public_url 使用 Server 对外地址且不带 /gateway。独立命令的连接参数迁入 gateway.conf 或环境变量。

    • 首次启动会用旧的 OPENVIKING_GATEWAY_ENCRYPTION_KEY 或 storage_path/encryption.key 解密旧数据，再按当前 OpenViking 加密配置写入。若希望继续加密，必须在首次启动前启用 OpenViking 加密；否则转换后的数据是明文。 缺少旧密钥时拒绝启动。
    • OPENVIKING_GATEWAY_ADMIN_TOKEN 不会自动变为管理密钥。需要限制配置修改时显式设置 gateway.management_key 或 OPENVIKING_GATEWAY_MANAGEMENT_KEY；没有管理密钥时，同账号普通用户也可修改共享上游和 context profile。root/admin 身份不能绕过已设置的管理密钥。
    • 旧上游 Base URL 会做一次迁移以保持原请求地址；新建/修改按新规则处理。更换上游 base_url 会清除已存的 API key 和请求头值，需要同次提交新地址对应的凭据。详见迁移指南。

  2. 移除独立 Session extract（#6131）。 POST /api/v1/sessions/{session_id}/extract 不再提供。改为 POST /api/v1/sessions/{session_id}/commit，再按返回的 task_id 查询后台结果。commit 会按策略归档消息，与旧的直接抽取不同；受理不代表完成。

  3. 移除等待专用 timeout（#6048）。 资源、Skill、内容写入、删除和 system wait 的服务端/SDK/MCP 等待参数，以及 CLI 对应命令的 --timeout 已移除。保留 wait；请求时限由客户端 HTTP timeout 配置控制。升级 SDK 后删除方法调用中的 timeout=；不要把 HTTP 超时当成后台任务取消。

  4. write(mode="create") 不再保护已有文件（#5897）。 它现在是 replace 的兼容别名，会覆盖已有正文；batch write 的 create/replace/upsert 同样写成请求的最终正文。依赖旧 409 Conflict 的调用方必须调整，不能继续用 create 作为防覆盖保障。batch write 可按实际需求使用 expected_sha256 和 skip_conflicts；它们不等同于旧的仅创建语义。正文提交后遇到派生处理失败，重试 replace 类写入时使用最终正文，勿直接重放已成功的 append。

  5. trusted 模式要求 root key（#5947、#5946）。 所有部署（包括 localhost）必须配置非空 server.root_api_key；数据请求带匹配的 API key 和 account/user 身份头。trusted 模式新建身份不再生成个人 key，重置个人 key 返回 FAILED_PRECONDITION。已有 key 不会自动删除，也不参与 trusted 认证。

  6. 共享缓存、Account Store 与多写存储（#6011、#6014、#5933、#5955、#5741）。 将缓存命名配置迁到顶层 service_name，同一部署各实例保持一致，共享 Redis 的不同部署使用不同值。切换 Account Store Provider 不会自动迁移身份数据；MySQL 表需按仓库 SQL 事先建立，修改 service_name 会选择另一组逻辑分区。

    • V2 多写只直接读取 primary，primary 成功后异步持久化事件并同步 backup。旧 sync/ack/retry/operations/excludes/redirects 配置会警告后被忽略；旧持久化协议不自动转换。首次启用会导入 primary 现有文件，不删除 backup 额外旧文件。升级前完整备份，回滚时先恢复兼容备份，不能仅换回旧二进制。primary 写入与事件落盘之间崩溃可能遗漏复制事件，需从 primary 重建受影响 backup。

  7. Session idle 策略与检索校验（#6046、#5926）。 新传入的 idle_timeout_seconds 必须为 0 或至少 300 秒；存量 1–299 秒值仍可读取。检索 limit 和显式 node_limit 必须为正数。

  8. 插件采集替换范围扩大（#5937）。 captureFilters 的 s 替换规则现在也处理 tool input 的字符串值和 tool output；d/k 仍只用文本决定保留或丢弃。检查已有规则是否会改写需保留的工具内容。插件需在各宿主中单独更新，升级 Python 包不会自动更新插件。

  9. 非空用户组可以直接删除（#6282）。 删除组会移除其全部成员关系，但保留用户和凭证，不重写已有资源 ACL。依赖旧“先清空组才能删除”行为的管理界面应更新提示。

  10. 可选 MySQL Task Store（#6258）。 启用前安装 openviking[mysql] 并执行 openviking/service/sql/task_store_init.sql；配置 storage.task_store.provider="mysql"。不要让 FileStore 和 MySQL 同时作为同一部署的写入端。

已知限制

远端索引中，新导入资源的 glob 结果可能稍后才可见；写入后的即时检索应考虑重试。

感谢本次 12 位首次贡献者，名单见下方。

English

This release contains 151 commits since v0.5.0, covering Gateway deployment, privacy fields, batch writes, multimodal retrieval, and Session/task reliability. Read the migration notes before upgrading: this release changes APIs, write semantics and storage formats.

Highlights

  • Embedded Gateway. Run Gateway inside OpenViking Server with gateway.enabled; model and management traffic use /gateway. Standalone deployment remains supported. Studio adds quick setup, model-setting import and generation-based upstream tests. Exact endpoints, custom authentication headers and API-key URL placeholders cover providers such as Azure. A separate management key controls upstream/profile edits. Request preparation, streaming relay and response lookup use less CPU (#5960, #6100, #6101, #6107, #6118, #6026).

  • Privacy fields. Owner-bound references, explicit value resolution, field metadata, atomic PATCH, field/target deletion and stored-content scanning are available through the API and CLI. Scans default to dry-run and do not expose matched plaintext; duplicate registered values are reported as ambiguous. No-split file imports receive the privacy handling fix (#6161, #6260).

  • Batch writes. Batch-wide processing_mode, per-file tags/ACLs, byte-revision conflict checks and conflict-preserving writes extend the content API. vectors_only maintains file vectors without regenerating parent summaries. If derived-work submission fails after content is written, the API reports the error and keeps the committed content (#5897, #5750).

  • Retrieval. find and search accept ordered image arrays alongside text with a compatible multimodal embedder. Python SDK supports these inputs; ov search --mode context returns assembled context. Recalling a directory no longer hides new files below it. Planner prompts and work are bounded, and Hermes no longer boosts results for literal query-token overlap (#6128, #5951, #5982, #6039, #6007, #5712).

  • Sessions and background work. Task and queue-work tracking converge, queue work retains its owner, SessionCommit phase-2 failures become terminal errors, and archive completion follows saved task results. Reduced repeated reads improve message writes, Session APIs and deletion. Resource-reason extraction returns once accepted into the queue (#6043, #6122, #6136, #5772, #6153, #6175, #6270, #6165, #6265, #6077, #6157).

  • Deployment options. Redis-backed idle auto-commit, MySQL and Redis+MySQL Account Store providers, a shared top-level service_name, and V2 multi-write partition logs/checkpoints extend multi-instance deployments. File Account Store remains the default (#6046, #5933, #5955, #6011, #6014, #5741).

  • Compile and Studio. VikingBot Compile gains a plannable Map/Shuffle/Reduce flow and transient routing embeddings, with bounded retries and stalled-review detection. Studio improves workspace setup, saved connections and model configuration. ROOT can save startup configuration and restart supported single-worker servers, with an attempt to recover the previously running configuration if startup fails (#5750, #5989, #6133, #6066, #6148, #6177, #5730).

  • Integrations. A Microsoft Agent Framework context provider joins the framework integrations, now under integrations/frameworks/. LangChain/LangGraph, DSH, OpenCode and Hermes receive capture, initialization and session-state fixes. Shared plugins add the ov-resources skill and consistently forward extra headers and recall exclusions. Hermes Quick Local supports OpenViking 0.5 (#5578, #6017, #5980, #6070, #5908, #5878, #6092, #5988, #5616, #5254, #6243, #5935, #5936, #6114).

  • Reliability and observability. Model error/retry classification preserves input, authentication, timeout and network distinctions. Fixes cover long embedding inputs, PDFium rendering, SVG dependencies, encrypted snapshot restore, native vector-store errors and tenant filtering. Connector-import counts and ingestion-token metrics identify source types (#6047, #5950, #6102, #6045, #5771, #5952, #6049, #6052, #5803, #5945, #6245).

  • MCP downloads. download(uri) returns a single-use file URL, normally valid for ten minutes, with optional Gateway proxying. OpenViking needs no API key on that URL; an outer authenticated proxy may still require its own headers (#6119).

  • Commit and lock fixes. Sessions create their Task and bind its owner before enqueueing, fixing commit HTTP 500 errors. Write coordination waits for producer handoff and owned work before releasing locks, fixing subsequent move, replace and delete operations returning 409 after a completed write. Cross-process handoff cleanup and HTTP vector-store response parsing are also corrected (#6258, #6300, #6281, #6193).

  • Task storage, parsing and integrations. MySQL is an optional Task/Work backend; file remains the default. parsers.download_temp_dir controls parser temporary storage, and case-only filenames follow the underlying filesystem. Gateway avoids duplicate recall/new sessions for DSH and tool-less auxiliary requests; LangChain preserves roles and tool history. Memory updates no longer overwrite from a stale snapshot when the fresh read fails (#6258, #6298, #6295, #6275, #6075). Studio localization and dedicated Gateway documentation are expanded (#6292, #6287).

Upgrade and migration

pip install --upgrade 'openviking==0.5.1' 'openviking-sdk==0.1.16'
npm install -g @openviking/cli@0.5.1
ov search 'recent design decisions' --mode context --events-time-decay-protection 7d
ov privacy reference credential github-prod api_key

  1. Gateway migration (#5960, #6100). Stop the old process and back up its complete storage_path. Embedded client URLs change from http://host:1935/v1 to http://host:1933/gateway/v1; Anthropic uses http://host:1933/gateway. Standalone still defaults to port 1935 but also requires /gateway. Management moves from /api/v1/admin/gateway/* to /gateway/admin/*. Remove the old sidecar/port configuration, set public_url to the server origin without /gateway, and move standalone command-line connection settings into gateway.conf or environment variables.

    • On first startup, the old OPENVIKING_GATEWAY_ENCRYPTION_KEY or storage_path/encryption.key decrypts existing data before it is rewritten under the current OpenViking encryption configuration. Enable OpenViking encryption before this startup to keep data encrypted; otherwise the converted data is plaintext. Missing legacy keys prevent startup.
    • The old admin token is not a management key. Set gateway.management_key or OPENVIKING_GATEWAY_MANAGEMENT_KEY to restrict configuration edits. Without one, ordinary users can edit shared upstreams/profiles in their account. Admin/root identity does not bypass a configured management key.
    • Stored upstream URLs receive a one-time migration to preserve request destinations. Changing base_url clears stored provider credentials and header values; send credentials for the new destination in the same update. See the migration guide.

  2. Session extract removed (#6131). Replace POST /api/v1/sessions/{session_id}/extract with commit, then inspect its returned task_id. Commit archives messages under the retention policy; acceptance is not extraction completion.

  3. Wait-specific timeout removed (#6048). Remove method-level timeout= and the corresponding CLI --timeout from resource, skill, content, deletion and system-wait operations. wait remains; configure the client's HTTP timeout instead. An HTTP timeout does not cancel background work.

  4. Create now overwrites (#5897). write(mode="create") aliases replace and no longer returns the old existence conflict. Batch create/replace/upsert also write the requested final content. Callers relying on create-only protection must change; byte-revision checks and skip_conflicts are not equivalent to create-only semantics. Retry final-content replacement after derived-work failures; do not blindly replay an append that already succeeded.

  5. Trusted authentication requires a root key (#5947, #5946). Every deployment, including localhost, needs a nonblank server.root_api_key. Data requests carry the matching API key and account/user headers. New trusted identities have no personal key; resetting a personal key returns FAILED_PRECONDITION. Existing keys are not deleted and do not authenticate trusted requests.

  6. Shared cache, Account Store and multi-write (#6011, #6014, #5933, #5955, #5741). Move cache naming to top-level service_name; instances in one deployment share it, while distinct deployments on one Redis use different names. Account Store changes do not migrate identities automatically. Create MySQL tables from the repository SQL before use; changing service_name selects another logical partition.

    • V2 multi-write reads only the primary and persists events/replicates backups asynchronously after primary success. Legacy sync/ack/retry/operations/excludes/redirects settings warn and are ignored; old persisted protocols are not converted. First enable imports primary files without deleting extra backup files. Back up before upgrading and restore a compatible backup before rolling back the binary. A crash between primary write and event persistence can lose a replication event; rebuild an affected backup from the primary.

  7. Validation changes (#6046, #5926). New positive idle_timeout_seconds values must be at least 300 seconds (0 disables it); existing smaller values remain readable. Retrieval limit and explicitly supplied node_limit must be positive.

  8. Capture filtering (#5937). Substitution rules now rewrite strings in tool inputs and tool outputs. Drop/keep rules still examine text only. Review existing substitution rules and update plugins separately in each host; upgrading the Python package does not update installed plugins.

  9. Nonempty groups can be deleted (#6282). Deletion removes all memberships while retaining users and credentials; it does not rewrite resource ACLs. Update management UIs that assumed a group must first be emptied.

  10. Optional MySQL Task Store (#6258). Install openviking[mysql], apply openviking/service/sql/task_store_init.sql, and set storage.task_store.provider="mysql" before enabling it. Do not use FileStore and MySQL as concurrent writers for one deployment.

Known limitation

With a remote index, newly imported resources may become visible to glob after the import response. Allow for retries when querying immediately after writes.

Full Changelog / 完整变更

View release →

longbridge/gpui-kit ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v0.8.0 Stable2026-10-19T12:52:27Z

GPUI Kit v0.8.0

GPUI Kit 0.8.0 adds an installable JavaScript Shell runtime, Linux WebView support, and a public rendering boundary for external editors. It also adds lighter syntax highlighting with syntect, native-style scroll bounce, richer completion highlighting, and improvements to text selection, tables, focus and accessibility.

Runtime and platforms

  • Shell runtime: run and scaffold JavaScript applications with gpui-shell; package them with bundle, and use dev for reloading during development. (#3464, #3487)
  • WebView: use gpui-webview on macOS, Windows and Linux X11/XWayland. GPUI Fast enables overlays above native pages on macOS and Linux; bounds and clipping updates preserve the page viewport. (#3395, #3499, #3591)

This release updates the optional GPUI Fast backend to 0.1.10. The default backend remains pinned to gpui-pre 0.3.9, the latest published snapshot. The WebAssembly example uses wasm-bindgen 0.2.127 to match the updated backend dependency graph.

Editor and text input

  • External editors: gpui_kit::base::text::editor_host lets an editor render a BlockNode tree through TextView and collect keyed leaf geometry while retaining its own document model, selection, commands and undo. (#3580)
  • Syntax highlighting: enable the syntect feature for a lighter highlighter with bat’s syntax collection; tree-sitter takes precedence when both are enabled. (#3512)
  • Completion highlighting: configure Lsp::with_completion_highlighter or set_completion_highlighter with highlight_prefix, highlight_contains, highlight_characters, or a host callback returning byte ranges. (#3496)
  • Wrapping: display_map() and prewrap(...) are available on InputState and TextareaState as well as EditorState. Editor::size supports the shared control sizes. (#3483, #3495, #3564, #3480)
  • Software keyboards: configure input_action, autocorrect and autocapitalize; masked fields are identified as passwords, and clear/mask controls have accessible names. (#3557, #3555, #3554, #3562)
  • Fixed caret clipping in one-row viewports, caret visibility during reflow and height changes, vertical scroll clamping, scrollbar reach in auto-growing textareas, and caret crispness on click. (#3583, #3477, #3527, #3515)
  • Custom Find queries and case changes start near the viewport; an unchanged query retains its active occurrence. Android’s Back button keeps entered text when clean_on_escape is enabled. (#3584, #3556)

Markdown and text rendering

  • Selection format: SelectionFormat::SourceAcrossStyles copies plain text within a single style and Markdown source across styles. (#3517)
  • Copy uses the current gesture before repaint, including virtualized rich content. Unmounting a selection endpoint retires the old selection, so retaining and remounting a TextView cannot revive it. (#3589, #3588)
  • HTML <br> creates a line break, and <pre> / <pre><code> preserve their text and whitespace through HTML minification. (#3569, #3570, #3581)

Scrolling and motion

  • Scroll bounce: precise scrolling uses a shared boundary-bounce engine, enabled by default on macOS, iOS and Android. Desktop motion follows NSScrollView; ordinary line-wheel input does not bounce. Nested areas retain their own gestures. (#3500, #3484)
  • Horizontal strips: ScrollableMask::vertical_wheel maps a plain mouse wheel to horizontal scrolling and chains to the parent at the edge. (#3518)
  • Cubic-bezier easing preserves anticipation and overshoot, and transitions and presence retain duration precision. (#3432, #3590)

Components

  • DataTable: fit a column by double-clicking its resize handle or calling fit_col, with widths supplied by TableDelegate::fit_column; inspect the result with col_width. Configure fixed_cols_border, select_on_modifier_click and focus_ring. (#3489, #3482, #3523, #3565)
  • DataTable: Home/End select the first/last row in row mode; row selection preserves event propagation, and default column resizing is capped at 1200px while preserving explicitly assigned initial widths. (#3471, #3469, #3472)
  • Resizable: use the standalone resize_handle for application-owned handles and ResizablePanel::fixed to preserve a panel’s size when its container changes. (#3302, #3478)
  • Dock: subscribe to DockToggleEvent to distinguish user-driven dock toggles. (#3546)
  • MessageScroller: read the current reading position through MessageScrollerState::logical_scroll_top. (#3485)
  • Select: keyboard confirmation and reconciliation of changed items preserve the intended selection. (#3446)
  • Focus and accessibility: focus traps preserve containment and accessibility; disabled controls report their disabled state; sliders can be named with accessibility_label; settings fields inherit their setting’s title. (#3443, #3531, #3494, #3524, #3582)
  • Tooltip: switching between triggers is direction-independent; a pressed trigger remains dismissed until the pointer leaves, and removing a trigger dismisses its tooltip. (#3501, #3492, #3528)
  • Popover: keyboard activation inside content remains available. (#3586)
  • TabBar: overflow-menu actions call the tab’s own handler, the sliding indicator appears after the first frame, and TabVariant::Folder adds a folder presentation. (#3568, #3574, #3415)
  • Tree: selection and toggling happen on click rather than mouse-down. (#3567)

Shell APIs

  • Extensible catalog: gpui_shell::components::registry() returns the unfrozen component catalog for host additions. Registered state objects support release() so applications can promptly dispose of retained resources. (#3542, #3544)
  • Lists and transcripts: script lists support with_follow_mode("tail") and on_visible_range_change; item-count changes preserve the reader’s position. MessageScrollerState exposes append/prepend/splice, measurement and scrolling operations. (#3548, #3549, #3547, #3541)
  • Script components: the catalog includes WebView/WebViewState, and Base TextareaState exposes set_submit_on_enter for message composers. (#3532, #3550)
  • Runtime compatibility: scripts gain gradient backgrounds and custom shadows, more browser/Node-compatible runtime APIs, and corrected filesystem link handling. Script errors report their cause, and launching a window on Wayland no longer crashes during activation. (#3534, #3505, #3510, #3561, #3509, #3508)

Breaking Changes

Support Linux on X11 and rename the crate to gpui-webview (#3395)

The crate is renamed from gpui-wry to gpui-webview.

 [dependencies]
-gpui-wry = "0.7.1"
+gpui-webview = "0.7.1"

-use gpui_wry::WebView;
+use gpui_webview::WebView;

On Linux, applications using the WebView must start on X11:

-gpui_kit::application().run(|cx| { /* ... */ });
+#[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
+let app = gpui_kit::platform::linux(WindowingModes::X11);
+#[cfg(not(target_os = "linux"))]
+let app = gpui_kit::application();
+app.run(|cx| { /* ... */ });

Support gpui-pre and make gpui-fast optional again (#3591)

Applications that relied on gpui-webview switching them to GPUI Fast must now select GPUI Fast on gpui-kit and enable the WebView feature with it, to keep overlays above the page on macOS and Linux:

 [dependencies]
-gpui-kit = "0.7"
-gpui-webview = "0.7"
+gpui-kit = { version = "0.7", features = ["gpui-fast"] }
+gpui-webview = { version = "0.7", features = ["gpui-fast"] }

Without both they build on gpui-pre; with only one of them, gpui-webview fails to compile and names the missing feature.

Add SelectionFormat::SourceAcrossStyles (#3517)

SelectionFormat is not #[non_exhaustive], so code that matches it exhaustively needs an arm for the new variant.

 match format {
     SelectionFormat::Plain => ...,
     SelectionFormat::Source => ...,
+    SelectionFormat::SourceAcrossStyles => ...,
 }

Let an application build its own resize handle (#3302)

ResizeHandle::on_drag was #[doc(hidden)]; its constructor now takes &T instead of Rc<T>:

- .on_drag(DragPanel, |drag, _, _, cx| cx.new(|_| drag.deref().clone()))
+ .on_drag(DragPanel, |drag, _, _, cx| cx.new(|_| drag.clone()))

Bounce scrollable content like NSScrollView, by default on macOS (#3500)

No existing signature changes. Every existing call still compiles. Four defaults change behavior, compared with main:

1. ScrollBounce is enabled by default on macOS. On main it was enabled only on iOS and Android. A ScrollBounce created without .enabled(..) now bounces on macOS too. To keep it still:

- ScrollBounce::new(id, &handle, child)
+ ScrollBounce::new(id, &handle, child).enabled(false)

2. ScrollBounce owns vertical wheel scrolling by default. On main, the child scrolled itself and the wrapper only stretched the deltas the child left unused. Now the wrapper scrolls the handle itself, through the shared engine. Code that relied on the child-owned mode, such as touch emulation or synthesized drags, must ask for it:

- ScrollBounce::new(id, &handle, child).enabled(true)
+ ScrollBounce::new(id, &handle, child).enabled(true).scroll_wheel(false)

3. ScrollBounceMotion::default() changes on macOS, Windows and Linux. The defaults are now tuned to match NSScrollView, replacing the UIScrollView tuning:

  • tracking goes from 0.55 to 0.075.
  • response goes from 524 ms to ≈503 ms.
  • The stretch is capped at 36 px.

iOS and Android are unchanged. To keep the previous feel:

- ScrollBounce::new(id, &handle, child)
+ ScrollBounce::new(id, &handle, child).motion(
+     ScrollBounceMotion::default()
+         .with_tracking(0.55)
+         .with_response(Duration::from_millis(524)),
+ )

4. Scrollable components scroll differently.

  • They bounce on macOS. Scrollable (overflow_y_scrollbar()), List, DataTable, Tree, Select, Command, Textarea, Editor, Sidebar, Diff, MessageScroller, the settings page and scrollable TextView now bounce on precise scrolling. On main none of them did. Each one that has a builder can turn it off:

    - List::new(&state)
+ List::new(&state).scroll_bounce(false)

  • Nested areas no longer scroll together, on every platform. The innermost area under the pointer takes the whole gesture, including at its ends. On main:

    • Nested GPUI scroll divs scrolled together.
    • MessageScroller handed the wheel to an ancestor scroller once it reached an end.

    Neither happens now. Sidebar, Diff, MessageScroller, the settings page and TextView have no scroll_bounce builder; they always follow the platform default.

Everything else listed under Public API is new in this PR, and so additive.

Keep a scroll over text that can scroll, even at its end (#3484)

Scrolling over a textarea or editor whose text can scroll no longer reaches the page around it once the text is at its end: the rest of that swipe, its momentum, and later wheel flicks over the text stay in the input. Text that fits, and vertical scrolling over a single-line input, still scroll the page. No setting restores the old behavior; to scroll the page, move the pointer off the input.

Add Folder variant (#3415)

TabVariant is not #[non_exhaustive], so exhaustive matches need the new arm:

 match variant {
     ...
+    TabVariant::Folder => ...,
 }

Keep cubic-bezier anticipation and overshoot in Easing (#3432)

  • Code that relied on Easing::sample staying within [0, 1] for an out-of-range cubic-bezier curve now sees overshoot:
- let alpha = easing.sample(delta);
+ let alpha = easing.sample(delta).clamp(0., 1.);

Select the first or last row on Home and End in row mode (#3471)

In row mode, Home and End select the first or last row instead of the first or last column. No setting restores the old behavior: Left and Right still move to a column, and a host that wants Home and End to pick a column can select one with set_selected_col.

Don't stop event propagation in set_selected_row (#3469)

TableState::set_selected_row no longer stops event propagation. Custom handlers that require it must call cx.stop_propagation() explicitly.

Skip the notify in set_line_number when nothing changes (#3475)

In a code editor, set_line_number no longer notifies when the line numbers are already as asked. A caller that relied on that call to re-render the editor notifies it itself:

  state.set_line_number(true, window, cx);
+ cx.notify();

Notify from set_searchable only when it changes (#3576)

ListState::set_searchable no longer notifies when the list is already searchable or not as asked. A caller that relied on that call to re-render the list notifies it itself:

  list.set_searchable(true, cx);
+ cx.notify();

Add bundle to package an application, and a dev command (#3487)

--dev no longer implies --watch or a debug log. dev is the command that reloads.

- gpui-shell run -d app --dev
+ gpui-shell dev -d app          # reload + debug log
+ gpui-shell dev -d app --dev    # … and the relaxed sandbox, as before

InvocationKind gains a variant, so an exhaustive match over it needs a Bundle arm.

  match gpui_shell::host::parse_invocation(arguments)? {
      InvocationKind::Run => …,
+     InvocationKind::Bundle => …,
      …
  }

Fix the runtime gaps found by the gpui-shell benchmark apps (#3505)

gpui-shell run -d <dir> with a manifest now stores data under the manifest id, the same place the installed copy uses, instead of <dir>-<hash>. Data written by earlier development runs stays in the old directory.

process.env was absent before; scripts that feature-detected it with typeof process.env === "undefined" now see an object.

Capabilities' read and write roots for a local run now include the manifest's roots rather than only the app and data directories, so gpui-shell list reports a wider grant for manifests that ask for one.

Extend UI testing with semantic queries and Linux rendering (#3402)

Existing pointer helpers now retain held modifiers. Callers that deliberately require an unmodified click while modifiers are held can request it explicitly; ordinary calls and signatures remain valid.

- window.click("save", cx); // previously reset held modifiers implicitly
+ window.click_with_options("save", ClickOptions::new(), cx); // explicitly unmodified, then restores held state

Nested context-menu callers keep the same construction. The corrected interaction is:

- window.right_click("inner-trigger", cx); // both inner and ancestor menus opened
+ window.right_click("inner-trigger", cx); // only the innermost menu opens

Add find_all and configurable clicks to the UI test harness (#3384)

TestWindowExt gains two required methods: find_all and click_with_options. Downstream implementations must implement both. click_with_modifiers has a default implementation through click_with_options. Call sites continue to import only TestWindowExt for all window queries and interactions.

 impl TestWindowExt for MyTestWindow {
     // Existing methods remain.
+    fn find_all(&self, id: impl Into<ElementId>) -> Vec<ElementSnapshot> {
+        self.window.find_all(id)
+    }
+    fn click_with_options(&mut self, id: impl Into<ElementId>, options: ClickOptions, cx: &mut App) {
+        self.window.click_with_options(id, options, cx);
+    }
 }

Thank you to everyone who contributed code, documentation, testing, and feedback!

v2026.10.10-beta.2openclaw 2026.10.10-beta.2 Prerelease2026-10-19T12:23:09Z

2026.10.10-beta.2

Highlights

Changes

Fixes

  • Workspace safety: reject a multi-file apply_patch before changing files when a later update target is missing or its context does not match, preserving the original workspace for the next attempt. Commit-time I/O failures can still leave partial effects. (#160409; related #117742 and #127496) Thanks @masatohoshino, @obviyus, and @yetval.
  • Tool policy: run plugin before_tool_call hooks in standalone openclaw agent exec sessions so plugin tool guards take effect. (#159333; fixes #158824) Thanks @joseairosa and @obviyus.
  • Buzz: reconnect when a relay closes during NIP-42 authentication without terminating the Gateway or interrupting other channels and sessions. (#170591; fixes #147269) Thanks @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @jarvis-modern-mail, and @RomneyDa.
  • macOS downloads: save dashboard and conversation attachments through the native Save dialog while keeping the current page open. (#173654) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen.
  • OpenRouter onboarding: accept valid API keys with the default openrouter/auto model instead of rejecting setup with a route mismatch. (#173292; related #162798) Thanks @chandraveshchaudhari and @obviyus.
  • macOS setup: let fresh native profiles start the Gateway and complete automatic setup, including when supervised startup needs a retry. (#173246)
  • Gateway startup: follow a replacement model-runtime refresh instead of exiting when initial preparation is superseded. (#173366; related #173357) Thanks @Jackten and @RomneyDa.
  • Gateway logging: keep serving and shut down normally when a deleted temporary-directory backing path makes daily log rollover fail. (#160433; fixes #130807) Thanks @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @WadeOwenWatts, and @Patrick-Erichsen.
  • Gateway stability: stop session diff capture from opening live SQLite and hard-linked files, preventing SIGBUS crash loops when the shared-memory file is truncated. (#174017)
  • Native app updates: let Doctor finish agent database upgrades on native-first profiles instead of reporting success while the Gateway refuses to start on an older schema. (#174297)
  • Cron: plan history maintenance from run identities and load full payloads only for rows it updates, so large cron histories no longer exhaust the SQLite worker's memory and take channels down. (#174530; fixes #174078) Thanks @wangmiao0668000666, @RomneyDa, and @asikorskiy.
  • Windows Claude CLI: stop every turn with a stored Anthropic credential from stalling until the no-output watchdog when Claude Code never reads the credential pipe. (#174571; fixes #174204) Thanks @RomneyDa and @scalesmart.
  • Plugins: restore the SDK facade exports that published external plugins still import, so those plugins load again. (#173777; fixes #173386) Thanks @RomneyDa and @FtlC-ian.
  • Chat tools: keep the chat usable after removing a tool server that failed to start, cleaning up its failed startup before reporting the launch error. (#171397) Thanks @joelagnel.
  • Updates: bound the post-activation Doctor step by the update's allowance instead of waiting indefinitely with the Gateway down. (#173862)
  • Updates: keep Gateway-managed source updates from failing with missing backup modules after the runtime is replaced. (#173587) Thanks @vishnusenthil-16.
  • Updates: make openclaw update --no-restart honest for npm, pnpm, and bun installs, which restart themselves after the package is replaced, record the update as successful, and keep a still-serving older build unverified. (#173409, #174649; fixes #171311) Thanks @RomneyDa and @mwbroxson.

Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.10-beta.1..f90bd063751f2448330ee6abbb4c894508600d63 history: 24 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 24 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

farion1231/cc-switch ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v4.0.16CC Switch v4.0.16 Stable2026-10-19T10:46:34Z

CC Switch v4.0.16

本版本把托盘改为快捷面板，并修复了一批 Codex 与路由问题。现在点托盘图标会弹出面板，能看到各应用正在用的供应商、模式、额度和用量，也能直接搜索、切换供应商；想用原来的菜单，可以在「设置 → 通用 → 托盘样式」里换回。Codex 聚合模式下，会话在默认供应商和其他成员之间切换后不会再卡在原来那家反复压缩失败；Codex 走路由时，每次重启 CC Switch 都要重新登录 ChatGPT 的问题也已修复。Codex 经路由连 Chat 上游时，并行工具结果不再被中途插入的提示拆开、报 400；自己填的 GPT 上下文窗口对官方同名模型也生效了，4.0.13 加的 272K 封顶改为只限制借用原厂数据的窗口。上游是 5.5 模型时，Claude Code 路由和 Claude Desktop 路由模式都改用 5.5 的模型 ID。另外修复了智谱按量付费账号显示「额度没查到」、新建的火山套餐卡片额度直接报错、Windows 上认不出 fnm 管理的 Node 工具、空闲的卡片删不掉、编辑供应商时「获取 API Key」链接不见等问题，macOS 图标底色也改成了柔和的浅灰。OpenCode 的卡片现在可以设为 OpenCode 的默认模型。4.0 完整的更新内容请见 v4.0 发布说明。

English → | 日本語版 →

新增

托盘改为快捷面板（#8432）。在 macOS 和 Windows 上，点托盘图标现在会弹出快捷面板：「配置」页列出各应用正在用的供应商、当前模式（直连、路由、聚合用和主界面相同的颜色）和额度，可以搜索、切换供应商；「用量」页的趋势图跟随主界面选的币种和图表样式。macOS 上是系统毛玻璃，叠在深色窗口上也看得清；Windows 上是不透明卡片。想用原来的菜单，可以在「设置 → 通用 → 窗口与终端」的「托盘样式」里选「菜单」，立即生效，不用重启。Linux 仍是原生菜单，最上面多了一项「打开快捷面板」。

OpenCode 卡片可以设为默认模型（#8509）。OpenCode 启动时按 opencode.json 顶层的 model 选模型，以前 CC Switch 没法设置，只能手改文件。现在已添加的 OpenCode 卡片上有「设为默认」，选一个模型即可；只改顶层的 model，注释和 small_model 原样保留。

改进

MiniMax 官方预设默认用 MiniMax-M3.1-Flash（#8518）。Claude Code、Claude Desktop、Codex、Hermes、OpenCode、OpenClaw、Pi 都已更新，MiniMax-M3 仍可选择。

「获取 API Key」链接恢复为浅蓝色，不再带下划线。

侧栏「今日」恢复「今日」前缀，撤回 4.0.15 的改动。

价格更新：Kimi K3 补上缓存写入价（每百万 Token 3 美元，原来记成 0）；Step 5 Preview 的缓存读取价按阶跃星辰 10 月 14 日的调价改为每百万 Token 0.70 元；新增 qwen3.7-flash、qwen3.6-27b、qwen3.8-omni-flash 的价格。这两项改价会自动更新到已有的价格表，手动改过的除外。

智谱的「获取 API Key」链接去掉了邀请码。

土耳其语：改进了 17 处界面用语（#8481）。

预设： 新增 AllTokens SI。

修复

  • Codex 聚合模式下，会话换到另一家供应商后一直报错（#8485）。会话在聚合的默认供应商和其他聚合成员之间换模型时，Codex 会先用原来那家压缩上下文；那家额度用完时压缩失败，之后每一轮都卡在同一处。现在聚合模式下第三方路由的模型和聚合成员用同一套压缩标识，不会再触发这次压缩，已经卡住的会话也能恢复。官方路由不受影响。
  • Codex 走路由时，每次重启 CC Switch 都要重新登录 ChatGPT（#8431）。Codex 桌面版 26.1013 起，继续会话需要登录 ChatGPT。关闭「非接管切换时保留官方登录」、直连供应商是第三方时，退出 CC Switch 会收起登录并删掉 auth.json，下次启动也没有还回去。现在退出 CC Switch 时一律保留登录，真正退出路由时仍按这个设置处理；进入或接上第三方路由时，如果 auth.json 里没有登录，会还回最近收起的那份，之前已经这样丢掉的登录也能找回。
  • Codex 经路由连 Chat 上游时，并行工具结果被中途的提示拆开，报 400「No tool output found」（#7190、#7569）。例如 Codex 看图片时插入的 image_resize_notice。现在这类提示不再打断工具结果，校验严格的 Chat 上游（如 DeepSeek）不再拒收。
  • 自己填的 GPT 上下文窗口对官方同名模型不生效（#8366、#8350）。现在按供应商或按模型填的窗口都会写进 Codex 的模型目录，自动压缩的阈值随之调整；没填时仍用官方默认值。Codex 经路由连 Gemini 时如果输入超长，现在会返回 Codex 认得的「上下文超长」错误，让 Codex 自己压缩。
  • 4.0.13 的 GPT 272K 封顶把真有 1.05M 窗口的平台也封了。 现在只有借用原厂数据的窗口才封顶到 272K：同一地址的预设、models.dev 按地址认出的供应商用它们自己的窗口，手填的窗口也照用；GPT 窗口超过 272K 时，Codex、Hermes、OpenClaw、OpenCode、Pi 的表单会在输入框下方提醒。OpenRouter、Vercel AI Gateway、Cloudflare AI Gateway、DigitalOcean 的预设恢复 1.05M。
  • 路由下上游是 5.5 模型时，Claude Code 仍当成 5 的模型（#8450）。现在 Opus、Sonnet 档的上游是 5.5 时，写给 Claude Code 的是 claude-opus-5-5 / claude-sonnet-5-5，Claude Code 显示正确的模型，输出上限也从 64K 变为 128K；子代理模型同样处理。
  • Claude Desktop 路由模式下，目标是 5.5 模型时请求被上游拒收（#8082）。以前发布给 Desktop 的模型名固定是 claude-opus-5 / claude-sonnet-5，Desktop 按 5 的参数构造请求，5.5 上游不接受；手改生成的配置又会被下次写入覆盖。现在目标是 5.5 时发布 5.5 的模型 ID；映射表本身不变，旧配置发来的请求仍指向原来的目标。
  • Claude Code 经 Codex OAuth 使用带次数上限的 WebSearch 时直接报错（#7936）。以前只有强制使用 WebSearch 时才放行，现在不强制也能用，次数上限通过提示约束，超出次数时这一轮响应会在返回时截断。
  • 智谱按量付费账号的卡片显示「额度没查到」（#8465）。智谱卡片默认查套餐额度，没有 Coding Plan 的账号会被当成出错。现在没有套餐时改为显示账户余额（团队套餐不回落）。
  • 新建的火山 Agent / Coding Plan 卡片一上来就显示「额度没查到」（#8494）。火山的套餐额度要用账号的 AccessKey ID 和 SecretAccessKey 查询，不是推理用的 API Key。现在用量设置里会预选火山，但填好 AccessKey 之前不启用查询；一键导入链接里明确写了启用的，照常启用。
  • Codex 官方卡的编辑器里，auth.json 显示的是旧登录。 以前显示的是旧版本存下的登录快照，Codex 换过令牌后就和 ~/.codex/auth.json 对不上；跟随当前登录的卡片则显示为空。现在未绑定托管账号的官方卡显示的是切换到这张卡后 auth.json 的内容；不动这个框直接保存，卡片原来的登录信息保持不变。切换时实际写入的文件一直是对的。
  • Windows 上用 fnm 管理 Node 时，认不出已安装的 Codex 等工具（#8484）。fnm 只在各个终端里临时加 PATH，CC Switch 找不到 node 和 npm，应用内安装也报「'npm' 不是内部或外部命令」。现在会把 fnm 默认 Node 版本的目录加到 PATH 末尾，原有的 PATH 仍然优先。
  • 空闲的供应商卡片删不掉，提示「无法删除当前正在使用的供应商」（#8506）。常见于带着旧版 Claude Desktop 映射卡升级后，数据库里旧的「当前」标记还指着它。现在只看实际在用的直连供应商和路由目标，和界面上禁用删除的规则一致。
  • 编辑供应商时「获取 API Key」链接不见了。 现在编辑时会按当前地址找到对应的预设，显示它的链接，和添加时一样。
  • macOS / Linux 上误报环境变量冲突。 以前会把 CC Switch 从启动它的程序继承来的环境变量也算进去（例如从 Claude Desktop 打开的终端里自带的 ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL），这些在应用里也删不掉。现在只检查 shell 配置文件里的定义，Windows 不变。
  • MiniMax Code 的部分用量记录模型显示为 unknown。 现在会从同一会话、同一时间的那条回复里找回模型名，能正常计价；已经导入的记录保持原样。
  • Hermes 里添加 MiniMax 官方供应商后请求发不出去（#8538）。供应商标识按直觉填成 minimax 时，和 Hermes 内置的 MiniMax 重名，Hermes 会改用内置那家、要求设置 MINIMAX_API_KEY。现在 MiniMax 预设会预填 cc-switch-minimax / cc-switch-minimax-en；之前已经用 minimax 添加的，请改用别的标识重新添加。MiniMax-M3.1-Flash 也标为支持图片输入。
  • 中文和日文下用量图的纵轴太宽。 「5000万」「2000亿」这样的刻度改写成「5千万」「2千亿」，用量页和托盘面板的纵轴按最宽的刻度自动调整宽度，短刻度不再留空，长金额不再被截掉。
  • macOS 图标的白底太亮（#8495）。4.0.15 的白色圆角方块改为浅灰，形状不变；Windows 和 Linux 图标不变。
  • 「关于」卡片的 Logo 模糊（#8470）。改用矢量图。

升级说明

数据库结构没有变化，仍然是 20。

  • 升级后点托盘图标会弹出快捷面板；想用原来的菜单，请到「设置 → 通用 → 托盘样式」里选「菜单」（macOS、Windows）。Windows 上左键点托盘图标以前是打开主界面，现在也弹出面板，主界面从面板底部的「打开主窗口」进入。
  • 已保存的 GPT 模型窗口不做迁移。4.0.13 之前保存、自动填成 1.05M 的 Codex GPT 模型，这个值现在会生效；打开表单时会看到提醒，如果实际只有 272K，请手动改小。

致谢

感谢 @Owlbay（托盘快捷面板）、@funkpopo（托盘快捷面板、GPT 上下文窗口）、@parkavenue9639（Codex OAuth 的 WebSearch）、@waynesguan（Claude Code 的 5.5 模型 ID）、@A0150315（被拆开的工具结果）、@SaladDay（MiniMax-M3.1-Flash、Hermes 的 MiniMax 预设）、@alkank（土耳其语）的贡献。

感谢 @ht6231997Byte、@mybolide、@xiaohe622516、@Jokyuzx、@XiaoXiangGuRen、@BlueMain、@guaifinition、@fengzhcai、@Alicexs、@samuelhe52、@futurelyf、@actforjason、@yyhhkya、@107295472 报告问题、提供复现信息和修复思路。

完整的技术细节请见 CHANGELOG。

alam00000/bentopdf ↗ 2 releases · 2 stable
v2.8.10 Stable2026-10-19T10:14:20Z

[!WARNING] This release addresses security vulnerabilities (GHSA-v77x-cvmx-ggp4, GHSA-qch9-77q9-j7p6) affecting all versions up to and including v2.8.9. All users are strongly advised to upgrade to v2.8.10 immediately.

Full technical details will be published after the coordinated-disclosure window has passed.

Thanks to @marek-mraz, and @musicsms for responsibly disclosing these.

A little update from me

Hey everyone!

First off, I want to apologize for the slower releases lately. I haven't been doing too well health wise, so things slowed down quite a bit, and I haven't been able to review PRs or reply to issues as fast as possible

I'm doing much better now, though, and I'm happy to say that BentoPDF is going back to weekly releases!

I've been working on quite a few things behind the scenes, and the next update is going to be a big one. Here's what's coming:

  • Measurement tools: You'll be able to measure distances, perimeters, and areas directly on your PDFs.
  • Favorite tools: Pin the tools you use most so you don't have to keep looking for them.
  • Air-gapped by default: I'm gradually removing dependencies on third-party engines like Ghostscript and PyMuPDF and replacing them with our own engines, [Kura](https://www.bentopdf.com/kura) and [Hyper Compress](https://www.bentopdf.com/hyper-compress).
  • A much faster Organize: I've spent a lot of time optimizing the Organize tool, and the performance improvements are pretty significant.
  • Digital signatures: PAdES signatures with timestamps and long-term validation, along with certification signatures.
  • Dark mode and color-blind modes

Most of my time, though, went into building a new lightweight, SOTA OCR engine for PDFs. It's fast, it performs at the level of vision language models (VLMs). Beyond reading text, it handles:

  • Tables: Recognizes tables, including merged cells, and reconstructs them into proper rows and columns that you can export to Excel or HTML.
  • Formulas: Recognizes mathematical expressions and converts them into LaTeX.
  • Markdown export: Converts entire pages into structured Markdown, preserving headings, lists, tables, and formulas.
  • JSON export: Provides recognized text along with its position on the page and confidence scores.
  • Layout detection: Identifies paragraphs, headings, lists, tables, captions, footnotes, forms, and more.
  • Reading order: Handles multi-column documents, magazines, and complicated layouts without mixing everything up.
  • PDF tagging: Can help turn unstructured PDFs into properly tagged documents.

And yes, at one point I genuinely thought training an OCR model on my poor GTX 1650 was a good idea. <img width="512" height="512" alt="GTX" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/485b30ce-575e-47d1-8e2d-2cb437302de5" />

code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v5.1.38 Stable2026-10-19T10:11:33Z

5.1.37 was tagged but its publish stopped on Linux (the release binaries outgrew their size budget), so its main packages never reached npm; everything listed for it ships in this release. (#10566)

Release binaries may be up to 182 MiB. The per-platform size budget moves from 160 MiB to 182 MiB after measuring what grew: the Bun 1.4.3 runtime adds 9.5 MB to every binary and the senpi update about 1.25 MB, so linux-x64 reached 173.4 MB. Nothing was bundled by mistake. (#10566)

5.1.36 was prepared but never published; everything listed for it ships in this release. (#10552)

The engine moves to senpi 2026.10.19: a hung extension handler no longer freezes a session, and queued input survives a crash. An extension handler that never settles on a lifecycle event is named in the session after 60 s and released after 20 min, or at once on Esc or the turn deadline. Input queued with a client id is written to the session file before it is queued and delivered exactly once. The mouse wheel scrolls the transcript again while a question prompt is waiting, Alt+Q restores queued messages on WSL, and the /btw panel no longer repeats a running eval's output in the scrollback. Anthropic requests of 4096+ characters to api.anthropic.com are now sent gzip-compressed, as Claude Code does. (senpi#3650, senpi#3549, senpi#3604, senpi#3628, senpi#3649, senpi#3643, #10552)

Goals keep going while they make progress, and long sessions open and stay light (senpi 2026.10.18-1). A goal no longer stops after a fixed 150 automatic continuations; it stops only after 60 in a row with no new tool effect, todo change or message from a person, and says why and that any message resumes it. Opening a very large session on a shared host no longer stalls the other sessions, a reopened session keeps only its latest compaction window in memory (four of the largest local transcripts went from 1441 MB to 216 MB of live heap), and reading a very long history over RPC pages instead of dropping the connection. A Claude subscription from CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN or an ambient Claude Code login now shows as a connected subscription, and a host daemon inherits every credential variable the engine reads. Provider accounts can be ordered, and grep starts 5 to 14 rg processes where it used to start 63 to 87. (#10280, #10509) The engine also fixes ChatGPT browser sign-in dead-ending on "State mismatch." when another session holds the callback port (senpi #3627), and a compiled engine now finds the Claude Code binary shipped beside its executable instead of failing the lookup (senpi #3640).

A client re-attaching to a retained session gets the full task snapshot again, and can pull it on demand. The task RPC bridge listens for session_resumed, which senpi fires when the first client re-attaches to a still-open session, and re-emits the complete omo.task.updated snapshot instead of waiting for the next store change to alter its fingerprint; a new omo.task.list request answers the same payload for the parent session it names. (#10016, #10122) Memory recall's search index takes a quarter of the memory it did, and a memory write no longer rebuilds it. Every session that recalls memory keeps a search index of the whole memory. It stored each note's words as a separate table, so a memory of 6,406 notes cost about 231 MB per session, and each memory write threw the index away and rebuilt it, taking 3 to 11 seconds. Words are now numbered once and each note keeps a compact list of numbers that survives a memory write, so the same memory costs 55 MB and a write updates the index in about 16 ms. The notes found and their order are unchanged. (#10510, #10512)

A background task child follows its session when another client replaces it. A raw RPC client that issues new_session, switch_session or fork on a daemon child's routing handle moves that session to a new durable id and transcript; the child now observes the session_replaced record, re-stamps its record's session path and durable id, appends a replaced task event, and reattaches to the new transcript instead of the abandoned one. When the replacement stops a turn the child was running, the child ends interrupted with the reason and a task_send action, and the parent is notified because it did not ask for that stop (a parent's own interrupt stays silent); this needs a senpi that names the cause on agent_end (senpi#3357), and an older host keeps the previous error. (#10018, #10112) unspecified-low tries GLM 5.3 before GPT. A user with Claude and Z.ai (or OpenCode Go) but no Xiaomi or xAI provider used to fall from Sonnet 5.5 straight to GPT-6.1 Sol once Sonnet was unavailable. The chain now has glm-5.3 at high thinking right after Grok 4.7 and ahead of the GPT rungs, so the order for users who hold MiMo or Grok is unchanged. (#10306, #10311)

omo --help no longer moves your OpenCode config before you start a session. On a fresh install --help (and --list-models / --list-tips) loads the omo extension, and its startup migration moved ~/.config/opencode/oh-my-openagent.json into ~/.omo/migration-backup-*, so a 4.19.x OpenCode plugin fell back to its defaults. The migration now runs only on launches that can start a session, and --help still lists omo's own flags. Thanks to @bluet for the report and @twotnguyen for #10433. (#10428, #10454)

Built, tested and released on Bun 1.4.3. CI, the release workflows and the devcontainer move from Bun 1.4.2 to 1.4.3, the current stable release, which fixes CVE-2026-48618 (TLS host names) and idle garbage collection in workers. (#10432)

OpenCode edition: Sisyphus names GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Luna as themselves. On gpt-6.1-sol (and its -fast, dashed and Venice gpt-61-sol ids) and on gpt-6-luna, the Sisyphus and Sisyphus-Junior GPT prompts introduced the model as "a GPT-family model"; they now say "GPT-6.1 Sol" and "GPT-6 Luna". (#10291, #10292)

Memory session shutdown waits for the work it started in the memory directory. Shutdown now waits, within its existing drain budget, for an in-flight repo maintenance pass and for the status refreshes started at bind and settle, all of which run git inside the identity directory. Before, they could still hold files open after shutdown returned; on Windows the next delete of that directory failed with EBUSY/EFAULT, which is how the memory pressure-dream test failed intermittently in CI. (#10154, #10312)

Oh My OpenAgent loads on OpenCode 2. OpenCode 2 refused the plugin with Plugin must export a default definition with an id and an effect or setup function, because both entry points exported only the OpenCode 1.x shape. The server and TUI entries now also export an OpenCode 2 setup built with Plugin.define from @opencode/plugin, next to the OpenCode 1.x server and tui entries, which keep working as before. Each OpenCode 2 start shows a notice that points to OmO Native, with the install command and guide link. (#8485, #10439)

The frontend skill keeps coloured edge stripes off rounded cards, and a linter catches the ones that slip through. A card with a coloured stripe along one edge, its rounded corners bending the stripe, is one of the most recognizable marks of generated UI, and the skill only banned it when the stripe marked a selected or focused item. It now rules the stripe out before drafting, whether it decorates the card or marks state, and offers what to use instead: a tonal surface, a heading in the accent colour, a glyph, or spacing. The new check-accent-stripes.ts script finds the pattern in CSS, Tailwind classes, inline styles, and styled-components, and the skill's checklist runs it before visual QA. Focus rings, form validation, neutral dividers, and tables are left alone. (#10437)

A store extension's orderBy can only name columns its statement returns, and its text never reaches the SQL. orderBy used to be pasted into the gateway's ordered read as given, so a LIMIT, an OFFSET or a column the statement does not select failed as broken SQL (near "LIMIT": syntax error, no such column). Each comma-separated term must now be one of the statement's own output columns (matched case-insensitively, as SQLite does), optionally with COLLATE BINARY/NOCASE/RTRIM, ASC/DESC and NULLS FIRST/NULLS LAST. The ORDER BY is rebuilt from the matched column name and those fixed keywords. Anything else, including quoted or bracketed names, comments, look-alike Unicode letters and unknown columns, is refused with extension_schema_violation and a message that names the rule and the columns the statement does return; put a LIMIT in the statement itself. (#9626)

The standalone omo binary's omo setup carries your OpenCode model choices again. The release binary printed could not read the engine's model list (ENOENT ... '/package.json') and skipped the default model and agent/category picks, and it would have imported a user skill named like a bundled one over the bundled skill. Setup in the binary now reads the provider catalog and bundled skills it ships with; the npm install is unchanged. Thanks to @bluet for the report. (#10429, #10455)

Only you can stop computer use with the stop chord on macOS and Linux X11. A chord a program sends (the agent's own key presses, xdotool, another app posting key events) used to stop every session, and repeated, could keep computer use stopped; it is now ignored, while a press on a real keyboard still stops every running session at once. Wayland's shortcut portal cannot tell the two apart, and Windows follows in a separate change. (#10444, #10449)

On Windows every session can now arm the stop chord, and only a key press on a real keyboard triggers it. The chord used to be a RegisterHotKey registration, which only one process can hold: a second session's engine could not arm it, so its computer use refused input with StopPathUnavailable; and a chord a program sent (the agent's own key presses or any other app's SendInput) stopped computer use like a real press. A low-level keyboard hook now watches the chord in every session, ignores injected key events, and never swallows a key; one physical press stops every running session at once. (#10444, #10453)

Computer use works on arm64 Linux and Windows. Each OmO release now carries the desktop engine for Linux arm64 (glibc) and Windows arm64, built on native arm64 machines and checked with its self-test before upload. The compiled OmO binaries for those hosts include the engine, and an npm install downloads it on first use, where it used to report that no engine is built for the host. Musl Linux still has no engine. (#10440, #10442)

A memory-sync account can be recovered on a new device with a passkey. memory-core can enroll a dedicated recovery passkey and, on a fresh device, use it to rejoin the account: the device's native bridge derives the recovery keys from the passkey and keeps them in the main process, the device walks the served history from the recovery key's own record and pins it, and only a wrap that record vouches for is opened. A wrap the server made up is refused, whatever the server sends. Nothing syncs to a server yet. (#10412)

herdr agent prompt reaches OmO panes. herdr only types into a pane whose foreground process it can name, and the OmO engine runs as bun …/cli.js, so every OmO pane was refused with agent_not_ready. Under herdr, the interactive engine now starts with HERDR_AGENT=pi, the label herdr already shows for these panes. OmO drops it from the environment it hands to anything it starts. Thanks to @devswha for the report. (#10448, #10452)

A memory writer killed mid-commit no longer leaves the next writer stuck on a git lock, and a live commit's lock is never taken. When a memory writer dies holding a git index.lock or ref lock, the writer that takes over its memory-write lock now removes that lock, but only after proving the previous owner dead, seeing no other process still working in the repository (a killed writer's own git command can outlive it), and seeing no process holding the file open. When any of that cannot be proven, including when the open-file check is slow or never answers, the lock stays put and the write fails with an error that names each lock file, says why it was kept, and gives the way out: /memory unlock <path> re-checks that one lock, shows what it found, refuses while any live holder, repository user or memory writer is visible, and removes only that file after you confirm (--force skips the prompt in a non-interactive session, never a refusal). On Linux desktops and SSH logins where some of your own processes cannot be inspected, the automatic removal does not fire and this command is the way out; #10322 tracks making liveness independent of /proc. On Linux this check reads /proc directly, so recovery also works on minimal installs and containers without lsof. (#10177) (#10199)

Synced memory refuses a forged or reordered history on the device, the same way the server does. memory-core now checks every sync object, the hash chain linking them, and the device keyring folded from it, using the format the service ships. A device rejects a record signed by a key that was rotated out or revoked, a dropped or reordered entry, a recovery join from a removed recovery key, and a batch sealed for another account. It treats the server as untrusted: a device trusts an account history only if it starts from the root it pinned during its own pairing or recovery, so a history the server invents, or a different root that looks valid, is refused before any key is opened. A key wrap opens only from a record of that trusted history, and only through the device's own keyring. A missing or damaged pin is treated as no trust at all, and the device asks to re-pair or recover. A replayed batch, a swapped record body, an unsigned row in a vetoed epoch and a row with fields the format does not define are each refused and counted. Nothing syncs to a server yet. (#10178, #10298)

A memory that already exists on a device joins its synced space without losing anything. Each project's synced memory gets one identity that every device computes the same way from the repository, so two devices enabling sync offline land in one space. When local files meet the space's copy, nothing is deleted: body lines are only added, a list keeps every element from both sides, and a frontmatter value that differs keeps both whole values side by side, never spliced together and never a conflict note in the file. Leftover hub conflict copies are folded in and removed only after a read-back proves every line made it. Nothing syncs to a server yet. (#10206)

runtime_fallback moves to the next model when a Cursor pool is spent. cursor-opencode-provider reports a spent pool as capacity_limit, which the fallback classifier did not recognize, so the session ended on the error instead of trying the next rung of the chain. It is now treated like the resource_exhausted error it replaces. (#10170, #10224)

stablyai/orca ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v1.4.2301.4.230 Stable2026-10-19T06:30:00Z

Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️

The short version

  • Native chat (experimental): Use Antigravity in chat, choose which agents open as chats, and install a missing agent from the chat itself. Paste copied files as attachments, queue images, and see clearer feedback while attachments and queue actions are pending.
  • Accounts & agents: After switching Claude accounts, restart running sessions on the new account. Remove downloaded agent runtimes from Settings, and edit or delete Linear comments through the Orca CLI.
  • Phone: Edit queued messages in place, follow tool runs with desktop-style cards, and see your conversation immediately when resuming from history. Landscape phones put session tabs in the top bar, and Tasks makes clear which desktop you’re using.
  • SSH & remote workspaces: Disconnect stays disconnected, sleeping workspaces stay asleep, and closed tabs stay closed after reconnecting. Clearer server update and re-pairing messages help you recover a connection.
  • Everyday polish: Quick Command shortcuts follow the focused split, tab previews wait for the full hover delay, and file headers offer Reveal in Finder. Workspace cleanup better protects same-path projects on other machines.

Compatibility & upgrade notes

Native chat (experimental): Some chat features require support from the remote host. Keep the host updated alongside Orca to use the latest capabilities.

The orca command on SSH hosts: Existing hosts retain explicitly saved CLI control preferences; an unset preference is migrated to off. To allow commands on a connected SSH host to open and control this desktop’s Orca browser tabs for that host’s workspaces, enable Allow this host’s orca CLI to control Orca under Settings → SSH Hosts → edit the host → Advanced Connection.

Product experience

Native chat (experimental)

Choose which agents open as chats, use Antigravity, attach files and images more reliably, and see clearer queue, model and input-ownership feedback.

Agents, integrations & accounts

  • Pin Bun as a devDependency and typecheck with it by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30149

Broader regression coverage, dependency updates and internal cleanup support the changes above. Work on host-owned layouts and sidebar state remains behind disabled build switches.

Release notes

  • Changelog (fixes + features)
  • News (:help news in Nvim)

Install

Windows

Zip

  1. Download nvim-win64.zip (or nvim-win-arm64.zip for ARM)
  2. Extract the zip
  3. Run nvim.exe in your terminal

MSI

  1. Download nvim-win64.msi (or nvim-win-arm64.msi for ARM)
  2. Run the MSI
  3. Run nvim.exe in your terminal

Note: On Windows "Server" you may need to install vcruntime*.dll.

macOS (x86_64)

  1. Download nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz
  2. Run xattr -c ./nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
  3. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz
  4. Run ./nvim-macos-x86_64/bin/nvim

macOS (arm64)

  1. Download nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz
  2. Run xattr -c ./nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
  3. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz
  4. Run ./nvim-macos-arm64/bin/nvim

Linux (x86_64)

If your system does not have the required glibc version, try the (unsupported) builds for older glibc.

AppImage

  1. Download nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage
  2. Run chmod u+x nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage
    • If your system does not have FUSE you can extract the appimage:
      ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage --appimage-extract
./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim

Tarball

  1. Download nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
  2. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
  3. Run ./nvim-linux-x86_64/bin/nvim

Linux (arm64)

AppImage

  1. Download nvim-linux-arm64.appimage
  2. Run chmod u+x nvim-linux-arm64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage
    • If your system does not have FUSE you can extract the appimage:
      ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage --appimage-extract
./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim

Tarball

  1. Download nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz
  2. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz
  3. Run ./nvim-linux-arm64/bin/nvim

Other

  • Install by package manager
