studio-v2.45.0Reasonix Studio v2.45.0 Stable2026-10-19T02:09:00Z

本版新增定时任务、会话排序与跨项目移动、手机提醒、WSL 远程、Git 面板、反馈贡献榜、规则目录与按名称关闭工具，推理强度可在进行中的回合里切换，并修复内置浏览器页面缩放、终端卡顿、子代理识图等一批问题。

新增

  • reasonix schedule add|list|tick 等命令，在终端确认后按时间只读地运行任务；需用系统计划任务调用 schedule tick。关联 #11406。
  • Studio 打开且可见（窗口或托盘图标）时，会按计划自动运行已确认的定时任务；同一时刻只有一个内核执行。关联 #11406。
  • 会话菜单里可以把会话上移或下移，也可以在会话行上按 Alt+上下键；顺序保存在内核里，重启后不变。关联 #11420。
  • Linux 增加 .AppImage 下载（amd64 和 arm64），可直接运行；它不会自更新，新版本需重新下载。关联 #11653。
  • 浏览器和工作台可以全屏查看，会话与输入框暂时收起，按 Esc 或再点一次回到分栏；有事等你决定时自动退出全屏。关联 #11721。
  • 登录同一账号的手机可在有操作待批准、模型提问、一轮出错时收到提醒，通知只含类别和数量。电脑和手机两边默认都关，需分别开启。关联 #11878。
  • MCP 服务器因授权范围不够拒绝调用时，模型会停下，你可在该服务器那行点“授权更多权限”，每次都会先问你。关联 #11959。
  • 在“我的反馈”里可以撤回自己的反馈（命令行用 /feedback withdraw）；已登记的议题会被关闭，已有结论的反馈不能撤回。关联 #11995。
  • 可选的等级提示（设置里“等级提升时通知我”，默认关）：反馈等级提高时在窗口顶部提示一次，终端 /feedback list 说一行。关联 #12025。
  • 在“我的反馈”的对话里，你自己的回复旁会显示你的等级徽章，维护者的回复旁没有。关联 #12025。
  • 关联账号的电脑上，“我的反馈”会列出其他已关联设备的反馈和回复；终端新增 /feedback link、unlink、links。关联 #12073。
  • 设置 → 远程可以添加本机的 WSL 发行版：内核运行在发行版里，界面仍在 Windows；关闭 Studio 后内核随发行版停止，对话会保留。关联 #12225。
  • 终端界面的 /mcp 面板里，返回 401 的服务器可按 a 登录，要求更多权限的服务器可按 u 授权，都会先问你。关联 #12357、#11959。
  • ACP 会话支持 additionalDirectories，多文件夹工作区可让会话写入额外文件夹，仅限该会话，且经过与手动授权相同的检查。关联 #13114。
  • ACP 支持 $/cancel_request、消息块 messageId、权限请求带工具名，并按客户端声明转交 MCP 的表单与外部页面。关联 #13114。
  • 可选的追踪导出，在用户配置里开启并填写收集器地址后，每轮对话以 OpenTelemetry 追踪发给你自己的观测系统；默认关闭，只发结构和名称。关联 #13115。
  • 反馈面板里的“贡献榜”，按版本有名次，自己选择加入并预览名字，随时退出；终端用 /feedback board。服务端开启后才显示。关联 #13142。
  • 会话菜单里可以把会话移到另一个项目，只带走对话和标题、置顶、归档；权限设置、检查点、后台任务日志和排队消息不随移动，原件会被移除。关联 #13370。
  • 设置里的 SearXNG 地址旁新增「测试连接」，说明连不上的原因；只测已保存的地址，不连云元数据等地址；搜索失败时模型也收到同一原因码。关联 #13541。
  • 大文件优先引用本地路径，无路径时流式上传；默认 1 GiB 上传安全上限可由用户配置调整。关联 #13544 by @SivanCola。
  • 实验性，未经真实端点验证：原生 Gemini 提供方（Interactions API），支持思考、工具调用与视频（含 Files API）。关联 #13615。
  • 可在设置里打开“把视频地址交给模型厂商”（默认关闭）；只交你亲手写的 https 地址，厂商自己访问，智谱 GLM 与 Gemini（YouTube）支持。关联 #13616。
  • 子代理的面板行、完整记录标题和嵌套卡片都会显示它实际跑在哪个模型和强度上，失败或中断的也有。见 #13640 fixed in #13812。
  • 模型现在可以请你打开它需要的开关（比如派发到其他项目），你点一下确认才生效；安全边界类设置它永远改不了。关联 #13678。
  • 在输入框输入 # 可选一段本工作区的历史会话，作为只读资料带进这条消息；搜索命中也能引用，长度上限可在设置里调。关联 #13687、#11942。
  • 模型可用 task 的 task_id 给运行中的子代理补充指示，它在下一次调用工具时读到；设置里可调单条大小和每分钟上限。关联 #13693。
  • mod 的安装预览写明完全信任与静态清单；mod 可在输入框上方画一条带，它的提问会写明来源。关联 #13694。
  • 把鼠标移到你发的消息上，操作图标旁会显示这条消息的发送时间，长时间运行的任务可以据此核对起止时间。关联 #13697。
  • 设置 → 扩展里，你自己和项目文件夹里的技能多了「卸载…」，确认框写明要删除的位置；内置技能和由包提供的技能不显示。关联 #13714 fixed in #13725。
  • 终端里的 /mcp 面板现在可以添加和删除 MCP 服务器（按 n、d），添加前会完整显示将要运行的命令并要你确认。关联 #13754。
  • 工作台里的 Git 面板：改动按文件夹树显示，可整个文件夹暂存、丢弃单个文件的改动，推送前先预览目的地，历史里的提交可展开看文件和差异，非仓库的项目文件夹会按仓库分组显示。关联 #13821。
  • 终端里 /btw <问题> 在旁路问一个只读问题，答案只显示一次，不存入会话、不进入提示词。关联 #7950 fixed in #13757。
  • reasonix acp --permission-mode 供把 Reasonix 当子代理嵌入的宿主使用：固定审批姿态，客户端只能降低不能抬高，旧存档的更高姿态被限制且文件不改。议题 #13839。
  • 连接可以声明余额接口的返回格式；其他域名（如中转站）必须选择格式，否则显示未配置，也不发密钥。关联 #13736。
  • 设置里可以让新对话默认进入计划模式（agent.default_mode，默认关闭）；已有对话保持自己的模式。关联 #7852 fixed in #13760。
  • 状态栏显示当前按供应商哪个时段计费（高峰或平峰）和还有多久切换，只在模型用的是供应商自己的价格表时显示。关联 #8853。
  • Studio「人设」页提供用户级前后缀及运行时上下文开关；内置指令保留，项目不能设置人设。保存后在新会话或下次会话重建时生效。关联 #13588 by @SivanCola。
  • 连接编辑器里，每个模型价格下可填价格来源链接和核对日期（UTC）；只显示主机名，点击才打开，不会自动访问。议题 #13276。
  • 支持规则目录（.reasonix/rules、.claude/rules 和用户目录下的 rules），可用 paths: 限定到某些文件；不影响缓存前缀。关联 #9886 fixed in #13766。
  • 可以按名称关闭工具（[tools] disabled，设置里每个工具有开关），关闭后不再发给模型，调用会被拒绝；被其他功能依赖的保留并提示。关联 #8394 fixed in #13763。

变更

  • 服务商支持逐请求设置思考强度时，切换强度不再重建会话，进行中的回合里也能切，下一次请求起生效。见 #11411。
  • 会话等你回答时（含 Auto Guard 确认卡、沙盒越界提问）让出写入权；其间别的会话占了这些路径，会告知模型并记入回执，最长等待可设。见 #11531 fixed in #13842。
  • task 工具新增 task_id 参数，升级后的第一轮对话，工具说明的缓存会冷一次，之后恢复。关联 #13693。
  • 通过 ACP 连接时，失败的对话回合改为以 JSON-RPC 错误（-32603，data.code 为 turn_failed）结束，不再返回规范之外的 stopReason "error"。关联 #13703。
  • 通过 ACP 连接时，模型缺少密钥或尚未配置提供方，新建会话返回协议规定的“需要认证”错误（-32000），客户端可据此引导运行 reasonix setup。关联 #13705。
  • 通过 ACP 连接时，因“尚未验证”被暂停的回合以 end_turn 结束，响应带 paused 结果，文本末尾追加 [paused] 回执。关联 #13706。
  • 通过 ACP 连接时，状态类扩展通知需要客户端在初始化时声明 statusUpdates 才会发送，会话记录路径改放在响应的 _meta 里。关联 #13721。
  • 打开设置里的“派发”开关就是对派发的总同意：任务和回信不再出审批卡；新会话沿用发起会话的模型、预设、审批档位和计划模式，且不会更宽。见 #13526。
  • 已装的全信任权限扩展现在也会被已安装的 MCP 工具咨询（只能收紧，不能放宽）。见 #13694。
  • 常驻放行的会话间消息只会越过宿主自己设的暂停，不会越过你主动按下的暂停，它会留在队列里等你。关联 #13775。
  • 本机与 SSH 项目统一展示；“打开项目”移至标题旁的加号，支持统一折叠与展开。提交 da051abb2。
  • 会话采用中性选中背景；可选的悬停置顶、归档按钮默认关闭，菜单始终可用；修复环境切换、重复点击及焦点问题。PR #13638 by @SivanCola。
  • 远端读取与未指定目录的打开共用主机默认目录，已有会话不会改变读取目标或绕过禁用检查。PR #13638 by @SivanCola。
  • 未登记的 SSH 主机在连接前返回明确拒绝，远端写入接口的请求体限制为 64 KiB。PR #13638 by @SivanCola。

修复

  • 代码编辑器及其查找栏的字号现在跟随外观里的界面字号，不再固定在 12px 和 11px。关联 #11577。
  • 撤回反馈后，它对应的 GitHub 议题会被自动关闭（标记为不计划处理）。关联 #11995。
  • 迁移数据根之后，窗口里仍记着旧位置的会话现在能按文件名在新的会话目录里打开，不再提示“没有这个会话”。关联 #13152。
  • [[keep]] 标记的回合现在有自己的保留预算（窗口的 15%，新的优先），超出的旧回合并入摘要并提示；共享窗口的模型在回复空间用尽前就会压缩。见 #13320、#12773。
  • 压缩时摘要请求被供应商以“输入超长”拒绝，现在会按更小的输入重试（70%、50%、35%），而不是放弃这次压缩。见 #13320。
  • 有系统沙盒把 shell 限在项目文件夹里时，同一 git 仓库下两个项目里的会话不再因 bash 等无声明写入互相等待；没有沙盒（如 Windows）时仍整库互斥。见 #13335 fixed in #13851。
  • 委派任务里点名了粘贴的截图（.reasonix/attachments 下的文件）时，子代理现在能收到图并切到识图模型；技能子代理也不再悄悄丢图。见 #13642 fixed in #13876。
  • 刚进入窗格就打开分支菜单时，菜单会被自己的挂载收尾关掉，或一直停在加载中。关联 #13674。
  • 模型调用跨项目派发被拒时，会说明是“允许模型把任务交给别的会话”开关没开，并指出设置位置，不再和“此会话无法打开别的项目”混为一谈。关联 #13677 fixed in #13679。
  • 有新版本时，设置弹窗左侧列表里的「版本」一行也会出现和左下角设置图标一样的提示点，打开设置后能直接看到该点哪里。关联 #13682 fixed in #13685。
  • Windows 上会话文件名含大写字母（如自定义模型名）时，顶部标题和标签总显示“新会话”。关联 #13684。
  • 标题栏的搜索按钮在查找栏已打开时再点一次会关闭它，不再只是重新聚焦；快捷键和命令面板仍然是打开。关联 #13696 fixed in #13701。
  • 你自己发的消息下面的操作图标（复制、改写、回退）和 AI 回复下面的一样大，不再偏小。关联 #13699 fixed in #13704。
  • 侧栏搜索框有关键词时不再在失焦后收起，点搜索结果的第一下不会再因为列表上移而落空。关联 #13708。
  • 技能目录顶层放了 SKILL.md 时，卸载它会把整个技能目录连同其他技能一起删掉；现在只删这一个文件。关联 #13714 fixed in #13725。
  • 模型偏好里的“网页搜索”不再列出尚未添加的连接下的模型；选不了时的提示也改为“还没有添加”，不再误称“已被移出”。关联 #13806 fixed in #13813。
  • HTTP 连接里输入 ! 命令被拒后，命令会整段选中留在输入框，接着打字就是替换，下一条普通消息能直接发出。关联 #13810。
  • 智能体把页面排版到比窗格更宽的视口（如 1440 宽）时，内置浏览器只显示页面左侧一部分；现在整页缩放到窗格内显示。关联 #13811 fixed in #13835。
  • 智能体给内置浏览器页面设了比窗格小的视口时，页面居中显示，不再缩在窗格左上角；页面被缩小适配窗格时，智能体的点击仍落在原来瞄准的位置。关联 #13811 fixed in #13835。
  • 项目文件夹或外部文件夹被移走、改名或删除后，工具调用不再返回系统原话或“无匹配”，而是明确告诉模型和界面“文件夹不在了”，并在输入框上方提示重新选择。关联 #13833。
  • OpenCode Go 的新地址（opencode.ai/inference/go/…）不再因缺少会话标识而返回 400。关联 #13849 fixed in #13860。
  • 自定义提供商没有声明推理档位时，/effort 不再说“不支持”，而是告诉你在该条目里写 supported_efforts。关联 #13857 fixed in #13863。
  • 同一主机、不同端口的两个模型服务被合并成一个，新增的那个不显示；现在端口属于地址，各自独立显示，重复的条目也不再被丢掉。关联 #13858 fixed in #13865。
  • 终端界面里，命令输出很长、或思考/回答很长时，界面会越来越卡（每次追加都复制整段文字）；现在追加开销不再随长度增长。见 #13872。
  • Studio 窗口最小化时，智能体在内置浏览器里的点击被页面丢弃却报成功；现在输入前会不可见地升起窗口、之后恢复最小化（Windows）。见 #13628。
  • 你在卡片上批准的、别的会话发来的消息，在发送队列被暂停时不再只入队不处理，会单独开始，更早排队的内容仍保持暂停。关联 #13775。
  • 别的会话发来的消息正文里的 @ 不再被当成本地文件引用去读取，读不了的引用也不会再把发送队列暂停。关联 #13775。
  • 终端里刚启动就输入 /feedback 会提示“当前会话不可用”，要先 /reload 才行；现在启动后即可用。关联 #12073。
  • 用量页的「实付」不再包含订阅等价（Token Plan 之类）的估算；估算单独一行标为「等价估算」，每日明细里也并排显示。议题 #13276。
  • 已选「自动下载」时，打开设置里的版本页会立即检查一次新版本并开始下载，不必再等最长一天的后台检查。议题 #13683 fixed in #13875。

贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@SivanCola

<!-- lang:en -->

This release adds scheduled tasks, session moves, phone reminders, WSL remotes, a Git panel, a contribution board and rules directories, lets reasoning depth change mid-turn, and fixes browser scaling, terminal slowdown and sub-agent image reading.

New

  • reasonix schedule add|list|tick and friends: a read-only task runs when you confirm it in a terminal; call tick from your OS scheduler. Refs #11406.
  • While Studio is open and visible (a window or tray icon), it runs the schedules you confirmed; only one kernel ticks at a time. Refs #11406.
  • A conversation can be moved up or down from its menu or with Alt+Arrow on its row; the order is kept by the kernel and survives restarts. Refs #11420.
  • Linux gets an .AppImage download for amd64 and arm64 that runs in place. It does not update itself: download the next release. Refs #11653.
  • Full-screen browser and workbench with the conversation folded away; Esc or the button restores the split, and it exits by itself when something needs your decision. Refs #11721.
  • phones on the same account can be reminded when an action awaits approval, the model asks, or a turn fails; only the kind and a count are sent. Off by default on both sides. Refs #11878.
  • When an MCP server refuses a call for lack of access, the model stops and you can click "Grant more access" on its row; you are asked every time. Refs #11959.
  • You can withdraw your own report from My feedback (or /feedback withdraw in the terminal); its issue is closed, and a report with an outcome can no longer be withdrawn. Refs #11995.
  • An optional level-up notice (Settings "Tell me when my level goes up", off by default): one note at the top of the window, one line in /feedback list. Refs #12025.
  • In a My feedback thread, your level badge now sits beside your own replies and never beside a maintainer's. Refs #12025.
  • On a linked device, My feedback also lists reports and replies from your other linked devices; the terminal gains /feedback link, unlink, links. Refs #12073.
  • Settings, Remote can add a WSL distribution on this PC. The kernel runs in it and stops with it when Studio closes; conversations are kept. Refs #12225.
  • In the terminal /mcp panel, press a to sign in to a server that answered 401, or u to grant one the extra access it asked for; you are asked first. Refs #12357, #11959.
  • ACP sessions accept additionalDirectories, so a multi-folder workspace can give a session extra write roots, for that session only and with the usual vetting. Refs #13114.
  • ACP supports $/cancel_request, messageId on chunks and tool names on permission requests, and forwards MCP forms and pages when advertised. Refs #13114.
  • Opt-in trace export: once your user config enables it and names a collector, each turn goes to your own observability stack as OpenTelemetry traces; off by default. Refs #13115.
  • A contribution board in the feedback panel, ranked per release; you choose to join, preview the name and can leave. Terminal: /feedback board. Refs #13142.
  • Move a conversation to another project from its menu; permissions, checkpoints, task logs and queued messages stay behind and are removed. Refs #13370.
  • A Test connection button beside the SearXNG address says why an instance does not answer; it tests only the saved one, never a metadata address. Refs #13541.
  • Large files use native references or streaming; the default 1 GiB upload safety ceiling is user-configurable. Refs #13544 by @SivanCola.
  • (experimental, not run against the real endpoint) a native Gemini provider on the Interactions API with thinking, tools and video. Refs #13615.
  • a Settings switch (off by default) to hand a public video address you wrote to the model vendor, which visits it itself; Zhipu GLM and Gemini (YouTube). Refs #13616.
  • a sub-agent's panel row, full-record header and nested card now show the model and effort it actually ran on, failed or interrupted runs included. See #13640 fixed in #13812.
  • The model can now ask you to turn on a switch it needs (such as dispatching to another project), applied only when you confirm; boundary settings it can never change. Refs #13678.
  • Type # in the message box to reference a past conversation of this workspace as read-only material; search hits can be referenced too, with a size limit in Settings. Refs #13687, #11942.
  • The model can give a running sub-agent more guidance with task's task_id, read at its next tool call; Settings sets the size and per-minute limits. Refs #13693.
  • A mod's install preview states full trust and a static listing; a mod can draw a band above the prompt, and its questions say whose they are. Refs #13694.
  • Hovering your own message now shows when it was sent next to its action icons, so a long-running task's start can be checked against it. Refs #13697.
  • Settings > Extensions can remove a skill of your own or the project's, after a confirmation naming the place to be deleted; built-in and package skills do not offer it. Refs #13714 fixed in #13725.
  • The terminal's /mcp panel can now add and remove MCP servers (n, d), showing the full command it would run and asking you to confirm first. Refs #13754.
  • A Git panel in the workbench: a folder tree of changes to stage and discard, push with a preview, commit details, and a section per repository. Refs #13821.
  • In the terminal, /btw <question> asks a read-only side question: the answer is shown once and is not saved to the session or sent into its prompt. Refs #7950 fixed in #13757.
  • reasonix acp --permission-mode, for hosts embedding Reasonix as a subagent, fixes the approval posture: clients can lower it, never raise it; a higher saved posture is clamped. Issue #13839.
  • A connection can declare the format its balance endpoint answers in; a relay must pick one or shows as not configured and is not sent the key. Refs #13736.
  • Settings can start new conversations in plan mode (agent.default_mode, off by default); existing conversations keep their own mode. Refs #7852 fixed in #13760.
  • The status bar shows which of the vendor's billing windows (peak or off-peak) the model is in and how long until it changes, only where the model is billed at the vendor's own rate. Refs #8853.
  • Studio Persona settings add user-level prefix/suffix text and a runtime-context switch, preserving built-in guidance. Applies at the next session build. Refs #13588 by @SivanCola.
  • A model's price in the connection editor can carry a source link and a check date (UTC); only the host is shown, the link opens when clicked and is never fetched. Issue #13276.
  • Rules directories (.reasonix/rules, .claude/rules and the user's rules folder), optionally scoped to files with paths:; the cache-stable prefix is untouched. Refs #9886 fixed in #13766.
  • Tools can be turned off by name ([tools] disabled, a switch per tool in Settings): they leave every request and a call is refused; tools another feature needs stay, with a note. Refs #8394 fixed in #13763.

Changed

  • when the provider takes reasoning depth per request, changing it no longer rebuilds the session and works mid-turn, taking effect on the next request. See #11411.
  • a session waiting on you gives up its write claim, Auto Guard and sandbox-escape asks included; contention reaches the model and receipt, and the longest wait is a setting. See #11531 fixed in #13842.
  • The task tool gains a task_id parameter, so the tool-description cache is cold once on the first turn after upgrading and then warm again. Refs #13693.
  • Over ACP, a failed turn now ends with a JSON-RPC error (-32603, data.code turn_failed), not the non-standard stopReason "error". Refs #13703.
  • Over ACP, opening a session with a keyless model or no provider now returns the protocol's "Authentication required" error (-32000) so clients can offer reasonix setup. Refs #13705.
  • Over ACP, a turn paused as unverified now ends with end_turn, a paused outcome and a [paused] receipt at the end of the text. Refs #13706.
  • Over ACP, the vendor status notifications are sent only to clients that declare statusUpdates at initialize, and the transcript path moves into the response _meta. Refs #13721.
  • the Dispatch switch is your consent: tasks and replies come in with no card, and the opened session keeps the sender's model, preset, approval mode and planning, never wider. See #13526.
  • existing full-trust permission extensions are now also consulted for installed MCP tools (they can only tighten). See #13694.
  • A message let in by a standing release starts only over a pause the host set itself, never over one you pressed; it stays queued for you. Refs #13775.
  • Local and SSH projects share one list. Open Project moves to the heading's plus button, alongside collapse/expand all. Commit da051abb2.
  • Neutral session selection offers opt-in hover Pin and Archive, off by default; session menus remain available. Environment routing, repeated clicks, focus and stream budgets are fixed. PR #13638 by @SivanCola.
  • Remote reads and unqualified opens share the host default. Existing panes cannot redirect a read or bypass a disabled host. PR #13638 by @SivanCola.
  • Unknown SSH hosts are refused before connecting; remote mutation request bodies are limited to 64 KiB. PR #13638 by @SivanCola.

Fixed

  • The code editor and its search bar now follow the interface text size in Appearance instead of staying at 12px and 11px. Refs #11577.
  • When a report is withdrawn, its mirror GitHub issue is now closed automatically as not planned. Refs #11995.
  • After the data root is moved, a conversation the window remembers by its old location opens from the new session folder by file name. Refs #13152.
  • [[keep]] turns now have their own budget (15% of the window, newest first); older ones fold with a notice. Shared-window models fold before the reply runs out of room. See #13320, #12773.
  • when the provider refuses a compaction's summary request as too large, it is retried with a smaller input (70%, 50%, 35%) instead of giving up the fold. See #13320.
  • with an OS sandbox confining the shell to its folder, sessions in two projects of one git repository no longer wait on each other for bash writes; without one they still do. See #13335 fixed in #13851.
  • a delegated task naming a pasted screenshot (a file under .reasonix/attachments) now gives the sub-agent the image on the vision model; skill sub-agents no longer drop it. See #13642 fixed in #13876.
  • Opening the branch menu just as a pane settles no longer shuts it or leaves it loading forever. Refs #13674.
  • When cross-project dispatch is refused because the user's switch is off, the error now says so and names the setting, not a generic "cannot open sessions". Refs #13677 fixed in #13679.
  • When a newer release is known, the Version row in the settings list now carries the same mark as the gear, so the update entry is easy to find. Refs #13682 fixed in #13685.
  • on Windows the header and tab always read "New chat" when the transcript file name had upper-case letters (for example a custom model name). Refs #13684.
  • Pressing the title bar search button while the find bar is open now closes it instead of only re-focusing; the shortcut and the palette still open it. Refs #13696 fixed in #13701.
  • The action icons under your own messages (copy, edit, rewind) are now the same size as those under a reply instead of smaller. Refs #13699 fixed in #13704.
  • The rail's search box stays open while it holds a query, so the first press on a result is no longer lost to the list moving up. Refs #13708.
  • Removing a skill whose SKILL.md sits at the top of a skills folder deleted the whole folder with every other skill; it now deletes only that file. Refs #13714 fixed in #13725.
  • the web-search model picker no longer lists models from unadded connections, and a refused pick now says "not added" rather than "removed". Refs #13806 fixed in #13813.
  • Over an HTTP connection a refused ! command now stays selected in the box, so what you type next replaces it and the next ordinary message sends. Refs #13810.
  • A page the agent laid out wider than the pane (for example 1440 wide) showed only its left part in the built-in browser; it is now scaled to fit. Refs #13811 fixed in #13835.
  • A built-in browser page given a viewport smaller than the panel is centred at its own size, and clicks on a page scaled to fit the panel land where they were aimed. Refs #13811 fixed in #13835.
  • when a project or external folder is moved, renamed or deleted, tools now say the folder is gone instead of a bare system error, and the window prompts to choose it again. Refs #13833.
  • OpenCode Go's documented endpoint (opencode.ai/inference/go/…) no longer fails with 400 for lack of the session header. Refs #13849 fixed in #13860.
  • /effort on a custom provider with no declared reasoning levels now says so and points at supported_efforts instead of claiming the model does not support them. Refs #13857 fixed in #13863.
  • Two model services on one host but different ports were merged into one and the new one never showed; the port is now part of the address, and exact duplicates are listed too. Refs #13858 fixed in #13865.
  • the terminal UI slowed down as a command's output, an answer or its thinking grew, since each appended piece copied everything so far; appending now costs the same at any length. See #13872.
  • clicks the agent sent the built-in browser were dropped yet reported done while Studio was minimized; the window is now raised unseen for input, then minimized again (Windows). See #13628.
  • A message from another session that you approved on its card now starts even when the send queue is paused; what was queued before stays paused. Refs #13775.
  • An @token in the text of a message from another session is no longer read as a local file reference, and an unreadable one no longer pauses the send queue. Refs #13775.
  • In the terminal, /feedback said "not available in this session" until a /reload; it now works from the start. Refs #12073.
  • The usage page's paid figure no longer includes a subscription-equivalent estimate; it is its own labelled line and sits beside each day. Issue #13276.
  • With automatic download chosen, opening the Versions page now checks for a release at once and starts the download, instead of waiting for the next daily background check. Issue #13683 fixed in #13875.

ChatGPT Local Bridge Project lists, file lists and the latest reply are read from ChatGPT's own data, so a slow network no longer yields a partial list or an older reply. A reply ChatGPT failed to finish, or one held up by a usage limit, is reported as such instead of being returned as the answer.
ChatGPT Local Bridge The Voyager CLI can ask for the latest page data with voyager update (CLI 0.2.0 or later), instead of waiting for the next scheduled check.

tt-a1i/archify ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v3.2.0 Stable2026-10-19T00:43:00Z

Archify v3.2.0

Create a conclusion-first one-page answer from Markdown, with cited sources, interactive diagrams and browser exports.

Added

  • One-page answers (explainer) (#993). Ask your agent to answer as a page and Archify builds a conclusion-first explainer from a Markdown draft. Each panel answers one question, using prose, tables, steps, checklists, charts, code and validated native diagrams.
    • Authoring and delivery: finalize explainer validates, delivers atomically and checks the page. Charts come from a Mermaid fence or a CSV/JSON file next to the draft. Repository excerpts are read from the pinned commit. patch explainer replaces one panel by ID.
    • Reading:
      • Steps sit beside the diagram they walk through, and you can step through them.
      • Text and diagram nodes highlight each other.
      • Clicking a node opens the full Viewer focused on it.
      • Citations and source-linked nodes open source cards.
      • Each panel or selected passage produces a follow-up question that targets that panel.
    • Sharing: the page ships in four styles (clean, editorial, product, Swiss) with light and dark themes, and exports a PNG, WebP or JPG long image or prints to PDF.
    • Examples: four live pages in docs/cases/explainer/.
    • Credit: the one-page document direction of #942 by @goatliamia shaped this work.
    • Acknowledgment: thanks to @QingYunA for the early one-page diagram-and-explanation proposal and demo prototype.

Fixed

  • Explainer pages no longer carry local paths. The draft embedded in a page names its source and data files relative to the page, so a shared page does not reveal the author's directories. patch explainer resolves them against the page again.

  • Explainer long images keep the page's style and theme. A PNG, WebP or JPG export of a dark page, or of the editorial, product or Swiss style, came out in the light clean style, because the page is drawn inside an SVG where its <html> is not :root. The export now selects the page root by its own attribute.

  • Blank chart data is an error, not zero. An empty CSV cell, a JSON null or a missing field in a charted column no longer becomes a zero bar. Finalize names the column and row instead.

  • Workflow migration semantic contracts (#497). Layout planning no longer checks full-topology requirements against a temporary graph with routed edges removed. Migrated documents retain their authored contracts and must pass complete validation before publication.

  • Timeline 时区刻度（#926）。 刻度按显示时区在各真实时刻的 UTC 偏移对齐，修复跨夏令时后日刻度漂移到 01:00／23:00、半小时跳变后小时刻度漂移的问题。回拨的重复时刻保持独立，跳过的小时或日期不生成虚构刻度；事件时间、标签精度、时间轴比例与断轴规则保持不变。

Changed

  • Reader controls and node index. Compact bottom index rows keep descriptions below titles; menu and roving keyboard navigation respect modifier keys.
  • Update notices. Available updates include a release summary and an offer to help update. Network failures remain non-blocking.
  • Website and portability. The bilingual homepage and gallery introduce one-page answers while retaining guides and source-backed cases. Browser discovery, Windows command paths, source-directory whitespace and temporary-worktree cleanup receive focused fixes.

Distribution

  • Download archify.zip below. Stable update notifications are published separately after the archive has been verified.
  • The separately versioned DSH plugin is not republished with this release; maintainers must select a pinned source and complete its host/package acceptance in a separate follow-up.

Full changelog: https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify/compare/v3.1.0...v3.2.0

1jehuang/jcode ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v0.99.0 Stable2026-10-19T00:33:52Z

Account failover, hibernation, and faster reloads

Highlights

  • Automatically retry turns on the next pool account when one hits a usage limit, including for Desktop and SDK clients
  • Hibernate idle sessions to free memory, with measured RAM status and transparent wake on the next interaction
  • Reload and resume large sessions much faster by showing the local transcript immediately and sending only new history

Improvements

  • Support OpenAI Ultrafast speed tiers for GPT-6.1 Sol, with Fast commands and hotkeys that apply promptly
  • Show saved accounts, cached quotas, and available resets in the startup account router and usage cards
  • Polish usage cards with responsive gauges and compact Mil and Bil token totals
  • Offer additional OAuth accounts in the login picker and reauthenticate saved accounts from it
  • Show cache misses inline with more accurate cache reuse diagnostics
  • Show Jcode inference spending balance
  • Compress OpenAI and Anthropic request bodies to reduce upload time
  • Build the /model picker off the UI thread for large remote catalogs
  • Reconnect only changed MCP servers instead of restarting all of them
  • Simplify swarm mode by removing the task graph and defaulting swarm root effort to low

Fixes

  • Keep startup headers and account rows on a single line at narrow widths
  • Show usage-limit rejections clearly instead of stale quota bars
  • Fix forked sessions failing on replayed Anthropic web search blocks
  • Count Gemini thinking and tool-use tokens correctly in usage
  • Keep streamed OpenAI output when the completion payload arrives empty
  • Preserve token usage when requests are cancelled or fail
  • Fix Windows named-pipe connections hanging or failing on startup probes
  • Fix Firefox cold starts blocked by stale zombie processes
  • Collapse expanded pinned todos and restore overall progress display

Full changelog: https://github.com/1jehuang/jcode/compare/v0.98.1...v0.99.0

What's Changed

Feature

  • feat(#5313): fail closed when artifact-frontmatter-equals matches more than one artifact by @davdittrich in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5392

Fix

  • fix(#4901): phase complete never lowers the body Completed Phases counter by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5425
  • fix(#4928): doc-writer handles targets with no runnable local entry point by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5432
  • fix(#4915): execute-phase hands the regression file list and wave-failure tally across blocks by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5428
  • fix(#4929): ui-researcher inventory gate cross-checks its first answer and falls back to the lockfile by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5435
  • fix(#4927): plan-phase catches truncated plans, unverified gate baselines and the reversibility conflict by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5436
  • fix(#4867): TDD review credits a RED-only probe plan with the GREEN of the plan that depends on it by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5444
  • fix(#4799): a sequential executor in a linked phase worktree can commit on its phase branch by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5445
  • fix(#4945): begin-phase replaces a wrapped Current focus whole and starts a gap-closure re-entry at the first plan to run by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5446
  • fix(#4956): the shared-ID gate reads ready-ids as JSON, so it can mark requirements complete by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5448
  • fix(#5449): the synthesizer returns SUMMARY.md inline when the runtime refuses to write it by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5450
  • fix(#4947): update-plan-progress reconciles the pending-plan tail, replaces a bare TBD, and reports a skipped Progress row by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5452
  • fix(#4972): phase complete names a verify:post audit that is missing or unresolved by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5453
  • fix(#4993): ship-note CI recovery no longer waits on the review state by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5459
  • fix(#5085): an isolated quick executor writes its SUMMARY at a worktree-relative path and stops on a guard denial by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5462
  • fix(#5017): every reader and writer of the defaults store resolves its root like the loader by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5463
  • fix(#5049): --prompt-file reaches review lanes that take the prompt path in argv by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5468
  • fix(#5050): docs-update --verify-only asks nothing; verifier results stay under project_root and never collide by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5472
  • fix(#5106): TDD gate accepts go test RED evidence, refuses build failures, and shares one test-file definition by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5475
  • fix(#5113): phase add touches only its inserted block and depends on a phase that exists by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5477
  • fix(#5045): scan command-valued git -c config for secret reads by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5478
  • fix(#5122): agent_skills self-load names its own type, supplies its launcher, and skips the persona fallback by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5481
  • fix(#5123): installed @ includes resolve for Kimi, and for Copilot and Antigravity with --config-dir by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5484
  • fix(#5473): extract the commit subject byte-wise so a 112KB message is not slow in a UTF-8 locale by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5485
  • fix(#5143): workflow shell fences capture the typed text once instead of splicing it by @trek-e in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5493

  • fix(#5287): the audit-milestone closure chain addresses the inserted phase, not the insert-after phase by @0xdhx in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5440
  • fix(#5051): honor workstreams in quick task state updates by @agammann in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5373
  • fix(#4890): separate global phase from roadmap counts by @agammann in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5374
  • fix(#5327): probe capability-lock's own start-time on the first lock acquire, not at module load by @behruznassre in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5434
  • fix(#5316): dispatch ship:pre step hooks in ship preflight by @davdittrich in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5391
  • fix(#5409): stop Brave fetch following redirects by @davdittrich in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5443
  • fix(#4926): accept any readable text-file input and exit non-zero when it cannot be read by @Maestro157 in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5314

  • fix(#5359): document reviewer-lane dispatch outside a phase and slug-vs-alias by @davdittrich in https://github.com/open-gsd/gsd-core/pull/5417

can1357/oh-my-pi ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v18.12.2 Stable2026-10-18T21:03:22Z

@oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

Changed

  • The failed-tool-call correction sent to DeepSeek models now also covers chat-template tool-call tokens written out as text, not only malformed DSML (#16216 by @H4vC)

Fixed

  • Fixed Ollama chat history estimates counting stripped native thinking and missing foreign thinking replayed as text, which skewed compaction after model switches (#16164)

@oh-my-pi/pi-ai

Added

  • Added nativeJudgmentImageBounds(): the image bounds a native judge enforces, its wire's transport limits tightened by the catalog's model bounds
  • Added Box judgment questions (BoxQuestion/BoxAnswer, TypeSafe Jev 1.14+ direct or through OpenRouter): each names the request image it searches by image index, and comes back as that image's edges as 0–1 fractions; text, OpenAI Decisions, and Workers AI judges reject them

Fixed

  • Fixed Muse Code usage going stale whenever its 5-hour window sits idle: the idle window now reports as unused, and weekly usage carries over from the last active window until its reset (#16193 by @eggpeat)
  • Fixed DeepSeek tool calls never running when the model writes them as chat-template tokens with _ in place of ▁, a missing ｜, or no per-call close (e.g. <｜tool_calls_begin｜>…<｜tool_calls_end｜>): they now run as tool calls, and any that still cannot be parsed are removed from history and reported to the model as a failed call (#16216 by @H4vC)

@oh-my-pi/browser-relay

Fixed

  • Fixed a relay tab close failing when Chrome refuses it for a moment (a tab being dragged); the extension retries it (#16119 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed tabs created for a relay request whose connection dropped mid-create staying open, and answers to such requests going to a later connection (#16119)
  • Fixed the relay resolving an old tab id to a different tab after a browser restart; the extension now reports each browser run (#16119)

@oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

Changed

  • Seeded TypeSafe jev-1.14.0 and OpenRouter typesafe/jev-1.14, and made them the judge role defaults and TypeSafe's default model; TypeSafe discovery keeps seeded ids its alias-only /v1/models listing omits

@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

Added

  • Added computer.backgroundFallback (takeover by default, or refuse): when a computer window input call has no background route, the tool reruns that one call in takeover, hands focus back to your app and says so in its result; refuse fails the call instead and also refuses the agent's own foreground requests (takeover: true, raise(), an activating apps.open, desktop input, and on macOS menus and AXOpen) (#15191 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added DeepSeek as a web search engine (web/deepseek), using DeepSeek's new Search API with your existing DEEPSEEK_API_KEY or stored deepseek credential
  • Added el.selectText(text, { prefix?, suffix?, select? }) to the macOS computer tool: it selects text (or places a caret) in a background app's text field without taking focus, moving the pointer or sending keys, so typing into that field replaces it (#15175 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added { takeover: true } to computer-use win.move, so a hover that a window refuses in the background can be retried in the foreground (#15173 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added a menu option to the computer tool's win.click, el.click, el.press and el.perform, so on macOS the call that opens a menu also chooses its item, e.g. menu: ["Add to", "Fonts"] (#15185 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added el.type(text) and el.press(chord) to the computer tool, which send text and keys to that element instead of wherever its window's focus is; on macOS and Windows nothing is sent when the element cannot be addressed without taking your focus (#15563 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added: pressing Escape during takeover input now stops computer use for the rest of the turn, and that session's later computer calls are refused, unsent, until your next message (#15564 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added the computer tool's UserIntervened error on macOS: input into an app you have used since the agent last read its window fails without sending, and the agent is told to read the window again and keep your edits (#15562 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added tui.completeScrollback: rows a growing HUD or dialog pushes off screen go straight to scrollback instead of missing from it until it shrinks (#15692 by @Ilm-Alan)

Changed

  • The computer tool and its errors no longer tell the model to retry with takeover: true, and its instructions tell it never to call raise() or apps.open(…, { activate: true }) to make input work (#15191 by @will-bogusz)
  • Computer-use window input with takeover omitted now stays in the background after computer.control.acquire, so an acquired grant no longer activates the target app or moves the user's pointer; pass takeover: true for foreground input (#15173 by @will-bogusz)
  • Pressing Escape in your own app no longer stops the computer tool's background window input unless task control is held; Escape in omp still interrupts it, and physical Escape still stops takeover input (#15176 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added Box questions to ChainJudge: they go only to Jev judges that answer them, and the box edges measure the image you passed even when it was padded to fit Jev's size bounds
  • A relay browser.open without app.target now opens its own background tab instead of adopting the visible one (after reinstalling the relay extension; older ones select it), and browser.close closes it; app.target still borrows an existing tab (#16119 by @nnnnoel and @will-bogusz)
  • Computer-use win.menu.items now needs exec approval and is rejected in read_only runs, since on macOS it makes the window key in its own application before reading its menus (#15184 by @will-bogusz)
  • The computer tool no longer takes over your screen for macOS drags and holds on sliders, scroll bars, splitters and steppers, modified clicks, right-clicks and scrolls; they run in the background (#15185 by @will-bogusz)
  • The default judge role now uses TypeSafe Jev 1.14 (typesafe/jev-1.14.0, then openrouter/typesafe/jev-1.14): jev-latest is TypeSafe's stable alias and answered as jev-1.13.0
  • Idle compaction on a 1-hour prompt cache (Anthropic long retention) now runs just before the cache entry expires, about 54 minutes after the last request, so the summary still reads the cached context; compaction.idleTimeoutSeconds still applies with a 5-minute cache or an unknown lifetime (#16198, #16204 by @H4vC)
  • Tool-call intents now say what the agent wants from the call's output and what it already knows (e.g. "Find where the retry delay is computed and whether it honours Retry-After; the client is in http.py") instead of a short label like "Reading config file"

Fixed

  • Fixed repeated status commands such as /goal show showing nothing after the first few times in a native terminal when the text had not changed
  • Fixed browser relay tabs that a browser already had open when its extension connected staying invisible to omp until they changed; opening such a tab by app.target could fail with "Selected tab did not become available before omp could attach"
  • Fixed Ollama Cloud sessions compacting too early on stripped thinking or too late after switching from another model (#16164)
  • Fixed Google sign-in rejecting the /login perplexity SSO browser window with "This browser or app may not be secure"; the sign-in browser no longer runs in automation mode (#16141)
  • Fixed task.softRequestBudget never stopping Cursor subagents (#16182 by @joseotaviorf)
  • Fixed image judgments (judge()/judge_batch() with images) leaving TypeSafe Jev for the local tiny model whenever an image fell outside Jev's 280–1568 px bounds, which most screenshots do: images are now resized into the bounds, and strips padded, before Jev sees them
  • Fixed a Codex turn stopping on "Request failed … unsupported_native_inflight_message" when you sent a message while the response was writing text; the session now keeps the partial reply and continues with your message
  • Fixed the bash tool dropping variables, functions, and shell options between calls whenever auto-background was on (the default): a call that starts in the foreground now runs in the session's persistent shell, a failing command under set -e or an exit no longer resets that shell, and a call that overlaps a still-running one says it ran in a temporary shell (#16153 by @alphastorm)
  • Fixed the macOS computer tool's StaleRef for an element the app rebuilt in place, such as an Automator rule popup after its neighbour changed, leaving the agent to re-read the window: it now names the one element of the window with the fields the ref was read with, for the agent to check before acting on it (#15574 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed an eval cell's timeout aborting an awaited tool.task(...) or tool.wait(...) and losing its subagents' results: time spent waiting on them no longer counts against the cell, as with agent() handles, while a turn cancel still stops them (#16154 by @alphastorm)
  • Fixed the Up arrow crashing omp with text.replace is not a function when history.db was damaged; recall skips unreadable rows, and a damaged store is moved aside to history.db.corrupt-* with every readable prompt, session title, and recap copied into its replacement (#15751 by @Shadorain)
  • Fixed browser tab.screenshot() raising Chrome over the app you were typing in and switching its visible tab; background tabs and windows behind other apps are now captured in place, including ones idle long enough that Chrome stopped drawing them, as is a relay or app.cdp_url tab the user switched away from (#15174 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed tabs omp opens through a relay shared by two browsers landing in whichever browser reconnected last; they open in the browser of the tab omp used last, else the one showing the first selected tab (#16119 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed a relay browser.close after a browser restart closing a tab the user had opened since, when Chrome reused the old tab's id; a tab omp opens while its browser's relay extension reconnects now waits for it instead of opening in another browser, and one Chrome finishes creating after the extension's connection dropped is closed (#16119)
  • Fixed computer.run and browser tab.run silently dropping args that were not an array (such as { args: { path } }) or were given with a code string, so the function ran without them after its first steps had already acted; both now throw before the run starts, while omitted or null args still pass none (#16149 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed computer helpers or browser tab calls started together (such as Promise.all over computer.window) failing with a bare "Computer worker is busy" or "Tab … is busy"; the error now says to await each call before starting the next, or group the steps in one computer.run or tab.run (#16149 by @will-bogusz)
  • Commands in bash can hand skill://, local://, and other file-backed URLs to external programs again (python skill://example-skill/tool.py "query"), and can run them from a cd'd writable URL directory such as local://; a URL the provider rejects, such as an unknown skill, now fails the command with the provider's error (#14838 by @koyzdev)
  • Fixed computer.apps.open returning before the app had a window, or never giving a hidden running app one; it now returns the app's frontmost window as window, waiting up to 3 s on macOS (#15184 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed a key you were typing on macOS arriving twice or more when omp exited after computer use (#15562 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed omp --restore and /retry reporting nothing to retry for a turn cut off by a process exit in a session that had used eval; the interrupted turn now continues (#16195)
  • Fixed session loading on Windows treating a session path with a regular-file component as a missing session (an empty session) instead of rejecting it with ENOTDIR like POSIX does (#16145 by @jchanghong023)
  • Fixed models from extension providers listed in enabledModels or --models missing from /model, the Ctrl+P cycle and the startup model scope notice until the background catalog refresh finished (#16096 by @skipper019)

@oh-my-pi/pi-natives

Added

  • Added a refuseMenu option to click, drag and holdMouse: a macOS background left click on a menu button or popup button, or a drag or hold starting on one, throws BackgroundUnavailable before anything is sent (#15191 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added a returnFocus option for window input with takeover: on macOS the takeover hands focus back to your app even if you clicked meanwhile, and only a third app you switched to keeps focus (#15191 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added DesktopSession.axSelectText (macOS) to select text in an accessibility element's value by UTF-16 range, refusing missing or ambiguous matches and returning the selection read back (#15175 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added a menu item path to click options and axPerform: a macOS click or action that opens a menu chooses that item, submenus included, and leaves no menu open (#15185 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added DesktopSession.axType and axKeyChord, which type into or press keys in one accessibility element; on macOS a field that does not report keyboard focus gets nothing and the error names what has focus; on Windows background input goes straight to the element's own control window and refuses a windowless element (#15563 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added DesktopSession.escapeStops and desktopEscapeStops(key), counting takeover input you stopped with physical Escape on macOS, Windows and X11, apart from host cancels (#15564 by @will-bogusz)
  • Added UserIntervened on macOS: keys and clicks stop at your first key or click in the app they go to, and input to an app you used since it was last read waits up to 5 s for you to pause, then fails without sending (needs Input Monitoring) (#15562 by @will-bogusz)

Changed

  • Reduced Mermaid XY-chart rendering overhead while preserving chart colors and layout (#16214 by @kyle-elliott).
  • Reading recent commit subjects in a long Git history now reads only the commits requested instead of walking the whole history (#16210 by @kyle-elliott).
  • Improved AST search and edit performance in directories containing many unsupported files (#16213 by @kyle-elliott).
  • Faster numbered source formatting for hashline reads (#16211 by @kyle-elliott).
  • Improved word-diff performance for inline change highlighting (#16212 by @kyle-elliott).
  • Window input calls, element axClick, axType and axKeyChord included, resolve to a DesktopFocusReturn (handedBack, previousPid, frontPid) when a macOS takeover ran, and to null otherwise (#15191 by @will-bogusz)
  • BackgroundUnavailable and partial-delivery errors no longer tell the caller to retry with takeover:true; they say whether any input was sent (#15191 by @will-bogusz)
  • Reduced allocation overhead for uncached, result-limited file searches in large directory trees (#16115 by @kyle-elliott).
  • Desktop window input with takeover omitted is now background on every platform even while task control is held; only takeover: true selects foreground delivery (#15173 by @will-bogusz)
  • Computer use's physical Escape stop now watches the keyboard only during takeover input (takeover: true, held control, desktop-level input, raises); without held control, an Escape the user presses in their own app no longer cancels background window input, which the host interrupt still stops (#15176 by @will-bogusz)
  • macOS background keys, typing, left clicks and menu commands now refuse with BackgroundUnavailable when aimed at a non-key window of the app you are using, or once you have come to the target app, instead of moving your typing there; keys sent while another window of the target app becomes key stop with InputFailed (#15184 by @will-bogusz)
  • macOS win.menu.items now makes the window key within its app before reading, so it takes the input lock and throws InputBusy while another operation holds it (#15184 by @will-bogusz)
  • macOS background drags and holds on sliders, scroll bars, splitters and steppers, modified clicks, right-clicks, Electron scrolls and Tk 8.5 clicks now run without bringing the app forward; drags that could pick up files or text still throw BackgroundUnavailable (#15185 by @will-bogusz)

Fixed

  • Fixed macOS UserIntervened missing your input during element writes (axSelectText, setValue, native-field typing, AX actions and popups), a reused Open/Save panel process id counting another app's input, and an event tap started during exit staying live (#15562)
  • Fixed macOS remote-screen press/holdKeys landing in a Screen Sharing window you brought forward during the layout read, iPhone Mirroring dropping a press right after a release, and a modifier two characters need being pressed twice (#15193)
  • Fixed the macOS focus guard missing switches while a click hit-test stalled and missing an app the action brought forward 200–500 ms after its last send; background actions now keep guarding for that window before returning (#15195)
  • Fixed macOS key rerouting sending your keys to the app you had left after you switched to a third app, letting a menu that still held the keyboard from an earlier action take your keys, and dropping a theft when key focus could not be read (#16140)
  • Fixed macOS keys and mouse buttons staying down when omp is killed or its native input code panics mid-gesture; a key or button you are physically holding is left for you to release (#15192 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed macOS and X11 background input throwing BackgroundUnavailable ("nothing was sent") after part of the call was already sent; it now throws InputFailed, and on macOS a call stopped because you came to the target app throws UserIntervened (#15191 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed macOS takeover InputFailed naming only the target window when another held focus; it now names the app's focused window, such as an alert or sheet, or the app that stayed in front (#15191 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed a macOS takeover: true click or key that opened a document or closed a sheet or panel leaving its app in front for good; focus now returns to your app unless you clicked or pressed a shortcut during the takeover (#15191 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed the in-process cksum --check panicking on a tagged checksum line that starts with ( (for example (file)= <hash>) instead of reporting it as an invalid checksum line (#16142 by @jchanghong023)
  • Fixed grep --path-separator leaving \ separators untouched in printed paths on Windows, so displayed paths no longer mix \ with the configured separator (#16143 by @jchanghong023)
  • Fixed macOS computer use reporting a working physical Escape stop (globalEscape: true) when Input Monitoring was turned off and the stop could not see keys; inputPermission now reports event-posting access, and permission errors name the terminal or IDE to grant (#15157 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed a persistent Shell session discarding its variables, functions, and options when a command ran exit or stopped under set -e; those now end only the command, and only a failed run resets the session (#16153 by @alphastorm)
  • Fixed a macOS element-ref StaleRef giving no lead when the app destroyed the element and put an identical one in its place: the error now names the one element of the window with the fields the ref was read with, registered as a new ref, and sends nothing to it (#15574 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed macOS takeover input sending the user back to their previous app when they clicked in the takeover target as the input ended, and keeping the target in front for good when they merely kept typing while takeover held it: a click, a shortcut (any key with Command or Control, such as Command-Tab or Control-Up, a function key or a Globe shortcut), or a switch to another app now leaves the front app to the user, and macOS refuses the hand-back if one came after the takeover's own input; plain typing alone no longer does, once Input Monitoring lets omp tell it apart (#15176 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed macOS background input taking keyboard focus from your app, which then dropped pastes and shortcuts until clicked again, and the focus guard sending your app back to the front just after you picked the target yourself (#15184 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed macOS background input doing nothing or landing in the wrong place for Chrome pages, apps with several windows, Finder, sheets, popovers, inline editors such as Finder's rename field, and system Open/Save panels; keys for a window behind its own focused sheet now throw InvalidTarget naming the sheet (#15184 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed TextEdit and Script Editor freezing after a background ⌘S, and background shortcuts reporting success when the app stopped answering; they now throw InputFailed saying the outcome is unknown (#15184 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed macOS win.menu.items and win.menu.select treating commands such as Font Book's File ▸ New Collection as disabled while the app was in the background or had not yet caught up with an edit (#15184 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed macOS openApplication leaving a hidden running app without a window and bringing Notes or Contacts to the front; it now shows the app behind yours and returns its first window (#15184 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed macOS background and takeover input refusing while your front app showed no window, as Finder does after a click on the desktop (#15184 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed a macOS background AX action that failed yet brought its app forward, such as AXOpen in Chrome's Open panel, leaving that app in front of yours (#15184 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed macOS background right-clicks, menu button presses and popup setValue leaving a menu open in the target app, which took your keyboard; the menu now closes, and a right-click or press that opened one throws InputFailed (#15185 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed a macOS menu path or background press() on a popup in an Open or Save panel, such as Automator's Where: popup, failing to find its menu (#15185 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed your typing landing in the macOS app a background action targets when that app brings itself to the front while you type (#15195 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed macOS background input sending you back to your previous app after you opened the target app from Spotlight during the action (#15195 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed an app that a macOS background action opens something in, such as TextEdit after a background ⌘O in Finder, staying in front of your app; it is sent back like the target (#15195 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed a key you typed on macOS reaching your app twice or more when a process holding a computer-use event tap exited; closeDesktopEventTaps() closes them first (#15562 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed macOS typing into Screen Sharing and iPhone Mirroring arriving as the wrong characters: it now presses your keyboard layout's keys, types unmodified text in the background and stops while you hold a modifier or Caps Lock is on, and iPhone Mirroring taps and scrolls land where aimed (#15193 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed your keystrokes landing in the app a macOS background action targets, or vanishing into a menu it opened, when it takes the keyboard mid-action; they now reach your app (#16140 by @will-bogusz)
  • Fixed computer use input that had already gone out, such as typed text, a shortcut or a click, reporting Cancelled when you stopped it moments later; the stop now ends the next call instead (#16202 by @will-bogusz)

@oh-my-pi/pi-tui

Added

  • Added ComposerPreferences.completeScrollback (default false): rows a growing HUD or dialog pushes off screen go straight to scrollback instead of being held back until it shrinks (#15692 by @Ilm-Alan)

Fixed

  • Fixed table charts picking the wrong label and measure columns when numbers group thousands with spaces (1 988, 17 083); they now read like 1,988 (#16175)
  • Fixed terminal capability replies relayed through win32-input-mode appearing as typed input in WSL terminals (#16137)
  • Fixed the status-bar activity spinner and turn timer freezing until the next keypress when the working-row loader is stopped mid-turn; an open turn window now repaints the status line on its own timer (#16109 by @tommymorgan).
  • Fixed pasting sometimes inserting a block of base64 text instead of the pasted text in terminals that deliver pastes through the Kitty clipboard protocol (OSC 5522), most often with dictation apps that paste for you; a slow paste now arrives whole, and keys typed while a paste never finishes are given back instead of lost (#16170 by @H4vC)
  • Fixed a streaming table bouncing everything below it up and down while its last cell was still being written (#16116 by @galtamam-cmyk)
  • Fixed inline images in iTerm2 being sized for the wrong cell shape, which left charts smeared or offset (#16118 by @galtamam-cmyk)

@oh-my-pi/pi-utils

Added

  • Added readSalvageableRows() to read the rows of a damaged SQLite table that are still readable, skipping only the damaged pages (#15751 by @Shadorain)

What's Changed

  • perf(walker): reduce allocations for ranked file finding by @kyle-elliott in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16115
  • fix(natives): report the macOS Escape stop honestly by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15157
  • fix(natives,coding-agent): name the element that replaced a stale macOS computer ref by @will-bogusz in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15574
